verses.he: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים וּפַרְעֹ֣ה חֹלֵ֔ם וְהִנֵּ֖ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.on: וַהֲוָה מִסּוֹף תַּרְתֵּין שְׁנִין וּפַרְעֹה חָלֵם וְהָא קָאֵם עַל נַהֲרָא
verses.en: It was at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh had a dream, and behold, he was standing on the bank of the river.

oe.t: It was at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh had a dream, and behold, he was standing on the bank of the river.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת יְפ֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וּבְרִיאֹ֣ת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.on: וְהָא מִן נַהֲרָא סָלְקָן שְׁבַע תּוֹרָן שַׁפִּירָן לְמֶחֱזֵי וּפַטִּימָן בְּשָׂר וְרָעְיָן בְּאַחְוָה
verses.en: Behold, from the river emerged seven cows, fine-looking and well-fleshed, and they were grazing in the reed grass.

oe.t: Behold, from the river emerged seven cows, fine-looking and well-fleshed, and they were grazing in the reed grass.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶׁ֧בַע פָּר֣וֹת אֲחֵר֗וֹת עֹל֤וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן֙ מִן־הַיְאֹ֔ר רָע֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וְדַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה אֵ֥צֶל הַפָּר֖וֹת עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.on: וְהָא שְׁבַע תּוֹרָן אָחֳרָנְיָן סָלְקָן בַּתְרֵיהוֹן מִן נַהֲרָא בִּישָׁן לְמֶחֱזֵי וַחֲסִירַן בְּשָׂר וְקָמָן לְקִבְלֵיהוֹן דְּתוֹרָן עַל כֵּיף נַהֲרָא
verses.en: And behold, seven other cows emerged after them, from the river, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood next to the cows that were [already] on the bank of the river.

oe.t: And behold, seven other cows emerged after them, from the river, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood next to [
opposite
] the cows that were [already] on the bank of the river.

verses.he: וַתֹּאכַ֣לְנָה הַפָּר֗וֹת רָע֤וֹת הַמַּרְאֶה֙ וְדַקֹּ֣ת הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַפָּר֔וֹת יְפֹ֥ת הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְהַבְּרִיאֹ֑ת וַיִּיקַ֖ץ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.on: וַאֲכָלַן תּוֹרְתָּא בִּישָׁן לְמֶחֱזֵי וַחֲסִירַן בְּשַׂר יָת שְׁבַע תּוֹרְתָּא שַׁפִּירָן לְמֶחֱזֵי וּפַטִּימָתָא וְאִתְּעַר פַּרְעֹה
verses.en: They ate—the bad looking, thin-fleshed cows [then ate] the seven fine looking, healthy cows, and Pharaoh woke up.

oe.t: They ate—the bad looking, thin-fleshed cows [then ate] the seven fine looking, healthy cows, and Pharaoh woke up.

verses.he: וַיִּישָׁ֕ן וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֖ם שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהִנֵּ֣ה ׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹל֛וֹת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד בְּרִיא֥וֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.on: וּדְמוּךְ וַחֲלַם תִּנְיָנוּת וְהָא שְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא סָלְקָן בְּקַנְיָא חַד פַּטִּימָן וְטָבָן
verses.en: He fell asleep and had a second dream. Behold, seven ears of grain [corn] came up on a single stalk, wholesome and good.

oe.t: He fell asleep and had a second dream. Behold, seven ears of grain [corn] came up on a single stalk, wholesome and good.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים דַּקּ֖וֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹ֣ת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.on: וְהָא שְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא לָקְיָן וּשְׁקִיפָן קִדּוּם צָמְחָן בַּתְרֵיהוֹן
verses.en: And behold, seven ears, thin and scorched by the east wind, grew up after them.

oe.t: And behold, seven ears, thin [
smitten
] and scorched [
beaten
] by the east wind, grew up after them.

verses.he: וַתִּבְלַ֙עְנָה֙ הַשִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקּ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים הַבְּרִיא֖וֹת וְהַמְּלֵא֑וֹת וַיִּיקַ֥ץ פַּרְעֹ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֲלֽוֹם׃
verses.on: וּבְלָעָא שֻׁבְּלַיָּא לָקְיָתָא יָת שְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא פַּטִּימָתָא וּמָלְיָתָא וְאִתְּעַר פַּרְעֹה וְהָא חֶלְמָא
verses.en: The seven thin ears swallowed the seven wholesome, full ears. Pharaoh woke up, and behold it was a dream.

oe.t: The seven thin [
smitten
] ears swallowed the seven wholesome, full ears. Pharaoh woke up, and behold it was a dream.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַתִּפָּ֣עֶם רוּח֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־כָּל־חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־כָּל־חֲכָמֶ֑יהָ וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לָהֶם֙ אֶת־חֲלֹמ֔וֹ וְאֵין־פּוֹתֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֖ם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.on: וַהֲוָה בְצַפְרָא וּמִטַּרְפָּא רוּחֵהּ וּשְׁלַח וּקְרָא יָת כָּל חֳרָשֵׁי מִצְרַיִם וְיָת כָּל חַכִּימָהָא וְאִשְׁתָּעִי פַרְעֹה לְהוֹן יָת חֶלְמֵהּ וְלֵית דְּפָשַׁר יָתְהוֹן לְפַרְעֹה
verses.en: In the morning, he was agitated. He sent and summoned all the wizards of Egypt and all its wise men. Pharaoh related his dream to them, but none could interpret them for Pharaoh.

oe.t: In the morning, he was agitated [
his spirit was beaten
]. He sent and summoned all the wizards of Egypt and all its wise men. Pharaoh related his dream to them, but none could interpret them for Pharaoh.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֔ים אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֶת־חֲטָאַ֕י אֲנִ֖י מַזְכִּ֥יר הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.on: וּמַלִּיל רַב שָׁקֵי (עִם פַּרְעֹה) לְפַרְעֹה לְמֵימָר יָת סָרְחָנִי אֲנָא מַדְכַּר יוֹמָא דֵּין
verses.en: The chief butler spoke to Pharaoh saying, I recall my sins today:

oe.t: The chief butler spoke to Pharaoh saying, I recall my sins today:

verses.he: פַּרְעֹ֖ה קָצַ֣ף עַל־עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתִ֜י בְּמִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֚ית שַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים אֹתִ֕י וְאֵ֖ת שַׂ֥ר הָאֹפִֽים׃
verses.on: פַּרְעֹה רְגֵז עַל עַבְדוֹהִי וִיהַב יָתִי בְּמַטְּרָא בֵּית רַב קָטוֹלַיָּא יָתִי וְיָת רַב נַחְתּוֹמֵי
verses.en: Pharaoh was enraged at his servants, and he placed me under guard in the house of the chief executioner; me and the chief baker.

oe.t: Pharaoh was enraged at his servants, and he placed me under guard in the house of the chief executioner; me and the chief baker.

verses.he: וַנַּֽחַלְמָ֥ה חֲל֛וֹם בְּלַ֥יְלָה אֶחָ֖ד אֲנִ֣י וָה֑וּא אִ֛ישׁ כְּפִתְר֥וֹן חֲלֹמ֖וֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ׃
verses.on: וַחֲלֵמְנָא חֶלְמָא בְּלֵילְיָא חַד אֲנָא וָהוּא גְּבַר כְּפִשְׁרַן חֶלְמֵהּ חֲלֵמְנָא
verses.en: We had a dream on the same night, I and he, each according to the interpretation of his dream, did we dream.

oe.t: We had a dream on the same night, I and he, each according to the interpretation of his dream, did we dream.

verses.he: וְשָׁ֨ם אִתָּ֜נוּ נַ֣עַר עִבְרִ֗י עֶ֚בֶד לְשַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים וַנְּ֨סַפֶּר־ל֔וֹ וַיִּפְתָּר־לָ֖נוּ אֶת־חֲלֹמֹתֵ֑ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ כַּחֲלֹמ֖וֹ פָּתָֽר׃
verses.on: וְתַמָּן עִמָּנָא עוּלֵם עִבְרָאָה עַבְדָא לְרַב קָטוֹלַיָּא וְאִשְׁתָּעֵינָא לֵהּ וּפָשַׁר לָנָא יָת חֶלְמָנָא גְּבַר כְּחֶלְמֵהּ פָּשָׁר
verses.en: With us there was a lad, a Hebrew, a slave of the chief of the slaughterers. We told him [about our dreams], and he interpreted our dreams, he interpreted each man’s dream accordingly.

oe.t: With us there was a lad, a Hebrew, a slave of the chief of the slaughterers. We told him [about our dreams], and he interpreted our dreams, he interpreted each man’s dream accordingly.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּֽתַר־לָ֖נוּ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֑ה אֹתִ֛י הֵשִׁ֥יב עַל־כַּנִּ֖י וְאֹת֥וֹ תָלָֽה׃
verses.on: וַהֲוָה כְּמָא דִּי פָשַׁר לָנָא כֵּן הֲוָה יָתִי אֲתֵיב עַל שִׁמּוּשִׁי וְיָתֵהּ צְלָב
verses.en: It came to pass, that as he interpreted for us, so did it occur; he restored me to my position, and him he hanged.

oe.t: It came to pass, that as he interpreted for us, so did it occur; he restored me to my position, and him he hanged.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶת־יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְרִיצֻ֖הוּ מִן־הַבּ֑וֹר וַיְגַלַּח֙ וַיְחַלֵּ֣ף שִׂמְלֹתָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.on: וּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וּקְרָא יָת יוֹסֵף וְאַרְהָטוּהִי מִן בֵּית אֲסִירֵי וְסַפַּר וְשַׁנִּי כְסוּתֵהּ וְעַל לְוַת פַּרְעֹה
verses.en: Pharaoh sent and summoned Yoseif. They hurried him out of the dungeon, but [Yoseif first] shaved and changed his clothes. And then came to Pharaoh.

oe.t: Pharaoh sent and summoned Yoseif. They hurried him out of the dungeon [
prison
], but [Yoseif first] shaved [
trimmed his hair
] and changed his clothes. And then came to Pharaoh.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְתִּי וּפֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֗י שָׁמַ֤עְתִּי עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תִּשְׁמַ֥ע חֲל֖וֹם לִפְתֹּ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר פַּרְעֹה לְיוֹסֵף חֶלְמָא חֲלֵמִית וּפָשַׁר לֵית לֵהּ וַאֲנָא שִׁמְעֵית עֲלָךְ לְמֵימַר דְּאַתְּ שָׁמַע חֶלְמָא לְמִפְשַׁר יָתֵהּ
verses.en: Pharaoh said to Yoseif, I had a dream and there is no one to interpret it. I have heard it said about you that you hear a dream so as to interpret it.

oe.t: Pharaoh said to Yoseif, I had a dream and there is no one to interpret it. I have heard it said about you that you hear a dream so as to interpret it.

verses.he: וַיַּ֨עַן יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֱלֹהִ֕ים יַעֲנֶ֖ה אֶת־שְׁל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.on: וַאֲתֵיב יוֹסֵף יָת פַּרְעֹה לְמֵימַר בַּר מִן חָכְמְתִי אֶלָּהֵן מִן קֳדָם יְיָ יִתֹּתַב יָת שְׁלָמָא דְפַרְעֹה
verses.en: Yoseif answered Pharaoh, saying, Not I. God will respond to the peace of Pharaoh.

oe.t: Yoseif answered Pharaoh, saying, Not I. [
from my wisdom but from before
] God will respond [
there be a response
] to the peace of Pharaoh.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף בַּחֲלֹמִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י עֹמֵ֖ד עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלֵּיל פַּרְעֹה עִם יוֹסֵף בְּחֶלְמִי הָא אֲנָא קָאֵם עַל כֵּיף נַהֲרָא
verses.en: Pharaoh spoke to Yoseif, In my dream, I was standing on the bank of the river.

oe.t: Pharaoh spoke to Yoseif, In my dream, I was standing on the bank of the river.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת בְּרִיא֥וֹת בָּשָׂ֖ר וִיפֹ֣ת תֹּ֑אַר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.on: וְהָא מִן נַהֲרָא סָלְקָן שְׁבַע תּוֹרָן פַּטִּימָן בְּשַׂר וְשַׁפִּירָן לְמֶחֱזֵי וְרַעְיָן בְּאַחֲוָה
verses.en: Behold from the river there emerged seven cows, well-fleshed and fine looking, and they were grazing in the reed grass.

oe.t: Behold from the river there emerged seven cows, well-fleshed and fine looking, and they were grazing in the reed grass.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶֽׁבַע־פָּר֤וֹת אֲחֵרוֹת֙ עֹל֣וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן דַּלּ֨וֹת וְרָע֥וֹת תֹּ֛אַר מְאֹ֖ד וְרַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר לֹֽא־רָאִ֧יתִי כָהֵ֛נָּה בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָרֹֽעַ׃
verses.on: וְהָא שְׁבַע תּוֹרָן אָחֳרָנְיָן סָלְקָן בַּתְרֵיהוֹן חֲסִיכָן וּבִישָׁן לְמֶחֱזֵי לַחֲדָא וַחֲסִירָן בְּשָׂר לָא חֲזֵתִי כְוָתְהֵן בְּכָל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם לְבִישׁוּ
verses.en: And behold seven other cows emerged after them, poor, very bad-looking and thin-fleshed. I never saw in the entire land of Egypt, such bad looking [cows.]

oe.t: And behold seven other cows emerged after them, poor, very bad-looking and thin-fleshed. I never saw in the entire land of Egypt, such bad looking [cows.]

verses.he: וַתֹּאכַ֙לְנָה֙ הַפָּר֔וֹת הָרַקּ֖וֹת וְהָרָע֑וֹת אֵ֣ת שֶׁ֧בַע הַפָּר֛וֹת הָרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הַבְּרִיאֹֽת׃
verses.on: וַאֲכָלָן תּוֹרְתָּא חֲסִיכָתָא וּבִישָׁתָא יָת שְׁבַע תּוֹרְתָּא קַדְמָיָתָּא פַּטִּימָתָא
verses.en: The thin, bad-looking cows, ate the first seven cows, which were the healthy ones.

oe.t: The thin, bad-looking cows, ate the first seven cows, which were the healthy ones.

verses.he: וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה אֶל־קִרְבֶּ֗נָה וְלֹ֤א נוֹדַע֙ כִּי־בָ֣אוּ אֶל־קִרְבֶּ֔נָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֣ן רַ֔ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּתְּחִלָּ֑ה וָאִיקָֽץ׃
verses.on: וַעֲלָא לִמְעֵיהֶן וְלָא אִתְיְדַע אֲרֵי עַלּוּ לִמְעֵיהֶן וּמֶחֱזֵיהֶן בִּישׁ כַּד בְּקַדְמֵיתָא וְאִתְּעָרִית
verses.en: They came inside them, but it could not be recognized that they had come inside them, [because] their appearance was as bad as it was previously. Then I woke up.

oe.t: They came inside them, but it could not be recognized that they had come inside them, [because] their appearance was as bad as it was previously. Then I woke up.

verses.he: וָאֵ֖רֶא בַּחֲלֹמִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֣ה ׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹלֹ֛ת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.on: וַחֲזֵית בְּחֶלְמִי וְהָא שְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא סָלְקָן בְּקַנְיָא חַד מָלְיָן וְטָבָן
verses.en: Then I saw in my dream that behold seven ears of grain [corn], wholesome and good, came up on one stalk.

oe.t: Then I saw in my dream that behold seven ears of grain [corn], wholesome and good, came up on one stalk.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צְנֻמ֥וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת שְׁדֻפ֣וֹת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְהָא שְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא נָצָן לָקְיָן שְׁקִיפָן קִדּוּם צָמְחָן בַּתְרֵיהוֹן
verses.en: And behold seven ears, shriveled, thin and scorched by the east wind, grew up after them.

oe.t: And behold seven ears, shriveled, thin [
smitten
] and scorched [
beaten
] by the east wind, grew up after them.

verses.he: וַתִּבְלַ֙עְןָ֙ הָשִׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקֹּ֔ת אֵ֛ת שֶׁ֥בַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִ֖ים הַטֹּב֑וֹת וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֶל־הַֽחַרְטֻמִּ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין מַגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃
verses.on: וּבְלָעָן שֻׁבְּלַיָּא לָקְיָתָא יָת שְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא טָּבָתָא וַאֲמָרִית לַחֲרָשַׁיָּא וְלֵית דִּי מְחַוֵּי לִי
verses.en: The thin ears swallowed the seven good ears. I said this to the wizards, but none of them could tell me [its meaning].

oe.t: The thin [
smitten
] ears swallowed the seven good ears. I said this to the wizards, but none of them could tell me [its meaning].

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה חֲל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶחָ֣ד ה֑וּא אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הִגִּ֥יד לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר יוֹסֵף לְפַרְעֹה חֶלְמָא דְפַּרְעֹה חַד הוּא יָת דִּי יְיָ עָתִיד לְמֶעְבַּד חַוִּי לְפַרְעֹה
verses.en: Yoseif said to Pharaoh, Pharaoh’s dream is one. What God is about to do, He has told to Pharaoh.

oe.t: Yoseif said to Pharaoh, Pharaoh’s dream is one. What God is about to do, He has told to Pharaoh.

verses.he: שֶׁ֧בַע פָּרֹ֣ת הַטֹּבֹ֗ת שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים֙ הַטֹּבֹ֔ת שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים הֵ֑נָּה חֲל֖וֹם אֶחָ֥ד הֽוּא׃
verses.on: שְׁבַע תּוֹרְתָּא טָבָתָא שְׁבַע שְׁנִין אִנּוּן וּשְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא טָבָתָא שְׁבַע שְׁנִין אִנּוּן חֶלְמָא חַד הוּא
verses.en: The seven good cows represent seven years, and the seven good ears represent seven years; it is one dream.

oe.t: The seven good cows represent seven years, and the seven good ears represent seven years; it is one dream.

verses.he: וְשֶׁ֣בַע הַ֠פָּרוֹת הָֽרַקּ֨וֹת וְהָרָעֹ֜ת הָעֹלֹ֣ת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִים֙ הָרֵק֔וֹת שְׁדֻפ֖וֹת הַקָּדִ֑ים יִהְי֕וּ שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י רָעָֽב׃
verses.on: וּשְׁבַע תּוֹרְתָּא חֲסִיכָתָא וּבִישָׁתָא דְסָלְקָן בַּתְרֵיהוֹן שְׁבַע שְׁנִין אִנּוּן וּשְׁבַע שֻׁבְּלַיָּא לָקְיָתָא דִּשְׁקִיפָן קִדּוּם יְהֶוְיָן שְׁבַע שְׁנֵי כַפְנָא
verses.en: The seven thin, bad [looking] cows who came up after them, represent seven years, and the seven empty, east wind—scorched ears, represent the coming of seven years of famine.

oe.t: The seven thin, bad [looking] cows who came up after them, represent seven years, and the seven empty [
smitten
], east wind—scorched [
beaten
] ears, represent the coming of seven years of famine.

verses.he: ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֶת־פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.on: הוּא פִתְגָּמָא דִּי מַלֵּילִית עִם פַּרְעֹה דִּי יְיָ עָתִיד לְמֶעְבַּד אַחֲזֵי לְפַרְעֹה
verses.en: This is the word that I have spoken to Pharaoh; what God is about to do, He has revealed to Pharaoh.

oe.t: This is the word that I have spoken to Pharaoh; what God is about to do, He has revealed to Pharaoh.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֛ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים בָּא֑וֹת שָׂבָ֥ע גָּד֖וֹל בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: הָא שְׁבַע שְׁנִין אָתְיָן שׂוֹבְעָא רַבָּא בְּכָל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Behold, seven years are coming during which there will be great abundance in the entire land of Egypt.

oe.t: Behold, seven years are coming during which there will be great abundance in the entire land of Egypt.

verses.he: וְ֠קָמוּ שֶׁ֨בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן וְנִשְׁכַּ֥ח כָּל־הַשָּׂבָ֖ע בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְכִלָּ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.on: וִיקוּמוּן שְׁבַע שְׁנֵי כַפְנָא בַּתְרֵיהֶן וְיִתִנְשֵׁי כָּל שׂוֹבְעָא בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם וִישֵׁיצֵי כַפְנָא יָת (עַמָּא דְ) אַרְעָא
verses.en: Seven years of famine will rise after them, and all the abundance will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will devastate the land.

oe.t: Seven years of famine will rise after them, and all the abundance will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will devastate the land.

verses.he: וְלֹֽא־יִוָּדַ֤ע הַשָּׂבָע֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֛י הָרָעָ֥ב הַה֖וּא אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֑ן כִּֽי־כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד׃
verses.on: וְלָא יִתְיְדַע שׂוֹבְעָא בְּאַרְעָא מִן קֳדָם כַּפְנָא הַהוּא דִּיהֵי בָתַר כֵּן אֲרֵי תַקִּיף הוּא לַחֲדָא
verses.en: Nor will be known the [former] abundance of the land because of that famine that will follow, for it will be very severe.

oe.t: Nor will be known the [former] abundance of the land because of that famine that will follow, for it will be very severe.

verses.he: וְעַ֨ל הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַחֲל֛וֹם אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה פַּעֲמָ֑יִם כִּֽי־נָכ֤וֹן הַדָּבָר֙ מֵעִ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמְמַהֵ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְעַל דְּאִתַּנֵּית חֶלְמָא לְפַרְעֹה תַּרְתֵּין זִמְנִין אֲרֵי תַקִּין פִּתְגָּמָא מִן קֳדָם יְיָ וְאוֹחִי יְיָ לְמֶעְבְּדֵהּ
verses.en: As for the dream being repeated twice to Pharaoh, it is because the thing stands ready before God, and God is hurrying to do it.

oe.t: As for the dream being repeated twice to Pharaoh, it is because the thing stands ready [
from
] before God, and God is hurrying to do it.

verses.he: וְעַתָּה֙ יֵרֶ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ נָב֣וֹן וְחָכָ֑ם וִישִׁיתֵ֖הוּ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וּכְעַן יֶחֱזֵי פַרְעֹה גְּבַר סוּכְלְתָן וְחַכִּים וִימַנִינֵיהּ עַל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Now Pharaoh should seek a man of understanding and wisdom, and place him in charge of the land of Egypt.

oe.t: Now Pharaoh should seek a man of understanding and wisdom, and place him in charge of the land of Egypt.

verses.he: יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְיַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַשָּׂבָֽע׃
verses.on: יַעְבֵּד פַרְעֹה וִימַנֵּי מְהֵימְנִין עַל אַרְעָא וִיזָרֵז יָת אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי שׂוֹבְעָא
verses.en: This is what Pharaoh should do: appoint officials over the land, and prepare the land of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

oe.t: This is what Pharaoh should do: appoint officials [
faithful men
] over the land, and prepare the land of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

verses.he: וְיִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת־כָּל־אֹ֙כֶל֙ הַשָּׁנִ֣ים הַטֹּבֹ֔ת הַבָּאֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ־בָ֞ר תַּ֧חַת יַד־פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֹ֥כֶל בֶּעָרִ֖ים וְשָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.on: וְיִכְנְשׁוּן יָת כָּל עִיבוּר שְׁנַיָּא טָבָן דְּאָתְיָן הָאִלֵּין וְיִצְבְּרוּן עִיבוּרָא תְּחוֹת יְדָא מְהֵימְנֵי דְפַרְעֹה עִיבוּרָא בְּקִירְוַיָּא וְיִטְּרוּן
verses.en: Let them gather in all the food during these good years that are coming, and let them store up grain under the hand [jurisdiction] of Pharaoh. Let the food be [kept] in the cities, and let them safeguard it.

oe.t: Let them gather in all the food [
grain
] during these good years that are coming, and let them store up grain under the hand [jurisdiction] of Pharaoh. Let the food [
grain
] be [kept] in the cities, and let them safeguard it.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֨ה הָאֹ֤כֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ לְשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־תִכָּרֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.on: וִיהֵי עִיבוּרָא גְּנִיז (לְעַמָּא דְ) לְאַרְעָא לִשְׁבַע שְׁנֵי כַפְנָא דִּי תְהֶוְיָן בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם וְלָא תִשְׁתֵּיצֵי עַמָּא דְאַרְעָא בְּכַפְנָא
verses.en: The food will be held in safe-keeping for the land, for the seven years of famine; which will be in the land of Egypt. Let the land not be cut off by the famine.

oe.t: The food [
grain
] will be held in safe-keeping [
stored away
] for the land, for the seven years of famine; which will be in the land of Egypt. Let the [
people of the
] land not be cut off by the famine.

verses.he: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.on: וּשְׁפַר פִּתְגָּמָא בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל עַבְדּוֹהִי
verses.en: This thing [plan] was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

oe.t: This thing [plan] was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲנִמְצָ֣א כָזֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר פַּרְעֹה לְעַבְדוֹהִי הֲנִשְׁכַּח כְּדֵין גְּבַר דִּי רוּחַ נְבוּאָה מִן קֳדָם יְיָ בֵּהּ
verses.en: Pharaoh said to his servants, Can [another] one like this be found, a man who has God’s spirit in him?

oe.t: Pharaoh said to his servants, Can [another] one like this be found, a man who has God’s spirit [
the spirit of prophecy from before God
] in him?

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶת־כָּל־זֹ֑את אֵין־נָב֥וֹן וְחָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר פַּרְעֹה לְיוֹסֵף בָּתַר דְּאוֹדַע יְיָ יָתָךְ יָת כָּל דָּא לֵית סָכְלְתָן וְחַכִּים כְּוָתָךְ
verses.en: Pharaoh said to Yoseif, After Elohim has informed you of all this, there is no one so understanding and wise as you.

oe.t: Pharaoh said to Yoseif, After Elohim has informed you of all this, there is no one so understanding and wise as you.

verses.he: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל־בֵּיתִ֔י וְעַל־פִּ֖יךָ יִשַּׁ֣ק כָּל־עַמִּ֑י רַ֥ק הַכִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.on: אַתְּ תְּהֵי מְמַנָּא עַל בֵּיתִי וְעַל מֵימְרָךְ יִתְּזַן כָּל עַמִּי לְחוֹד כָּרְסֵי מַלְכוּתָא הָדֵין אֵיהֵי יַקִּיר מִנָּךְ
verses.en: You shall be over my house, and by your word shall all my people be fed. Only by [virtue of] the throne will I be greater than you.

oe.t: You shall be [
appointed
] over my house, and by your word shall all my people be fed. Only by [virtue of] the throne [
of this kingdom
] will I be greater [
more honored
] than you.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְךָ֔ עַ֖ל כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר פַּרְעֹה לְיוֹסֵף חֲזֵי מַנֵּיתִי יָתָךְ עַל כָּל אַרְעָא דמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Pharaoh said to Yoseif, Behold, I have placed you in charge of the entire land of Egypt.

oe.t: Pharaoh said to Yoseif, Behold, I have placed you in charge of the entire land of Egypt.

verses.he: וַיָּ֨סַר פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖הּ עַל־יַ֣ד יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי־שֵׁ֔שׁ וַיָּ֛שֶׂם רְבִ֥ד הַזָּהָ֖ב עַל־צַוָּארֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאַעְדִּי פַרְעֹה יָת עִזְקְתֵהּ מֵעַל יְדֵהּ וִיהַב יָתַהּ עַל יְדָא דְיוֹסֵף וְאַלְבִּישׁ יָתֵהּ לְבוּשִׁין דְּבוּץ וְשַׁוִּי מָנִיכָא דְדַהֲבָא עַל צַוְּארֵהּ
verses.en: Pharaoh then took off his ring from his hand, and he placed it on Yoseif’s hand. He dressed him in linen garments, and put a gold chain around his neck.

oe.t: Pharaoh then took off his ring from his hand, and he placed it on Yoseif’s hand. He dressed him in linen garments, and put a gold chain around his neck.

verses.he: וַיַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗וֹ בְּמִרְכֶּ֤בֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְנָת֣וֹן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וְאַרְכֵּיב יָתֵהּ בִּרְתִכָּא תִנְיֵתָא (נ''י תִנְיָנָא) דִּי לֵהּ וְאַכְרִיזוּ קֳדָמוֹהִי דֵּין אַבָּא לְמַלְכָּא וּמַנִּי יָתֵהּ עַל כָּל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: He had him [Yoseif] ride in his second-ranking carriage, and they proclaimed before him, Avreich. He thus placed him over the entire land of Egypt.

oe.t: He had him [Yoseif] ride in his second-ranking carriage, and they proclaimed before him, Avreich [
”This is the associate of the king”
]. He thus placed him over the entire land of Egypt.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבִלְעָדֶ֗יךָ לֹֽא־יָרִ֨ים אִ֧ישׁ אֶת־יָד֛וֹ וְאֶת־רַגְל֖וֹ בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר פַּרְעֹה לְיוֹסֵף אֲנָא פַרְעֹה וּבַר מֵימְרָךְ לָא יְרִים גְּבַר יָת יְדֵהּ לְמֵיחַד זֵין וְיָת רִגְלֵהּ לְמִרְכַּב עַל סוּסְיָא בְּכָל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Pharaoh [then] said to Yoseif, I am Pharaoh, but without you, no man will lift his hand or his foot in the entire land of Egypt.

oe.t: Pharaoh [then] said to Yoseif, I am Pharaoh, but without you [
your permission
], no man will lift [
pick up
] his hand [
to carry a sword
] or his foot [
to ride upon a horse
] in the entire land of Egypt.

verses.he: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם־יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֣וֹ אֶת־אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וּקְרָא פַּרְעֹה שׁוּם יוֹסֵף גַּבְרָא דְמִטַּמְרָן גָּלְיָן לֵהּ וִיהַב לֵהּ יָת אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע רַבָּא דְאוֹן לְאִתְּתָא וּנְפַק יוֹסֵף (שַׁלִּיט) עַל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Pharaoh gave Yoseif the name Tzafnas Paneiach, and he gave him Osnas, the daughter of Poti Phera, priest of On as a wife. Yoseif [then] went out over the land of Egypt.

oe.t: Pharaoh gave Yoseif the name Tzafnas Paneiach [
the man to whom hidden things are revealed
], and he gave him Osnas, the daughter of Poti Phera, priest [
chief
] of On as a wife. Yoseif [then] went out over the land of Egypt.

verses.he: וְיוֹסֵף֙ בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעָמְד֕וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיַּעְבֹ֖ר בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וְיוֹסֵף בַּר תְּלָתִין שְׁנִין כַּד קָם קֳדָם פַּרְעֹה מַלְכָּא דְמִצְרָיִם וּנְפַק יוֹסֵף מִן קֳדָם פַּרְעֹה וַעֲבַר (שַׁלִּיט) בְּכָל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Yoseif was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. Yoseif left Pharaoh’s presence, and traversed throughout the entire land of Egypt.

oe.t: Yoseif was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. Yoseif left Pharaoh’s presence, and traversed throughout the entire land of Egypt.

verses.he: וַתַּ֣עַשׂ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע לִקְמָצִֽים׃
verses.on: וּכְנָשׁוּ דָיְרֵי אַרְעָא בִּשְׁבַע שְׁנֵי שׂוֹבְעָא עִיבוּרָא לְאוֹצָרִין
verses.en: The earth produced during the seven years of abundance by handfuls.

oe.t: The earth produced [
The inhabitants of the land stored up
] during the seven years of abundance by handfuls [
grain for store-houses

verses.he: וַיִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת־כָּל־אֹ֣כֶל ׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּתֶּן־אֹ֖כֶל בֶּעָרִ֑ים אֹ֧כֶל שְׂדֵה־הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתֶ֖יהָ נָתַ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.on: וּכְנַשׁ יָת כָּל עִיבוּר שְׁבַע שְׁנִין דִּי הֲווֹ בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם וִיהַב עִיבוּר בְּקִרְוַיָּא עִיבוּר חֲקַל קַרְתָּא דִּי בְסַחְרָנָהָא יְהַב בְּגַוָּהּ
verses.en: He gathered in all the food of the seven years [that was produced] in the land of Egypt, and placed the food in the cities. The food of the fields surrounding each city was placed within [the city].

oe.t: He gathered in all the food [
grain
] of the seven years [that was produced] in the land of Egypt, and placed the food [
grain
] in the cities. The food [
grain
] of the fields surrounding each city was placed within [the city].

verses.he: וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי־חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.on: וּכְנַשׁ יוֹסֵף עִיבוּרָא כְּחַלָּא דְיַמָּא סַגִּי לַחֲדָא עַד דִּי פְסַק לְמִמְנֵי אֲרֵי לֵית מִנְיָן
verses.en: Yoseif piled up grain like the sand of the sea—in great abundance, until that they gave up counting it, because there were no [more] numbers.

oe.t: Yoseif piled up grain like the sand of the sea—in great abundance, until that they gave up counting it, because there were no [more] numbers.

verses.he: וּלְיוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָרָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן׃
verses.on: וּלְיוֹסֵף אִתְיְלִיד תַּרְתֵּין בְּנִין עַד לָא עַלַּת שַׁתָּא דְכַפְנָא דִּילִידַת לֵהּ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע רַבָּא דְאוֹן
verses.en: Two sons were born to Yoseif before the years of famine came. They were born to him by Osnas, the daughter of Poti Phera, Priest of On.

oe.t: Two sons were born to Yoseif before the years of famine came. They were born to him by Osnas, the daughter of Poti Phera, Priest [
chief
] of On.

verses.he: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם הַבְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי־נַשַּׁ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.on: וּקְרָא יוֹסֵף יָת שׁוּם בּוּכְרָא מְנַשֶּׁה אֲרֵי אַנְשְׁיַנִי יְיָ יָת כָּל עַמְלִי וְיָת כָּל בֵּית אַבָּא
verses.en: Yoseif named the first-born, Menasheh, For God has made me forget all my trouble, and all that was in my father’s house.

oe.t: Yoseif named the first-born, Menasheh, For God has made me forget all my trouble, and all that was in my father’s house.

verses.he: וְאֵ֛ת שֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־הִפְרַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עָנְיִֽי׃
verses.on: וְיָת שׁוּם תִּנְיָנָא קְרָא אֶפְרָיִם אֲרֵי אַפְשַׁנִּי יְיָ בְּאַרַע שִׁעְבּוּדִי
verses.en: He named the second one Ephraim, Because Elohim has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.

oe.t: He named the second one Ephraim, Because Elohim has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering [
servitude

verses.he: וַתִּכְלֶ֕ינָה שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וּשְׁלִימַת שְׁבַע שְׁנֵי שׂוֹבְעָא דִּי הֲוָה בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: The seven years of abundance came to an end, [the good years] that were in the land of Egypt.

oe.t: The seven years of abundance came to an end [
were completed
], [the good years] that were in the land of Egypt.

verses.he: וַתְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָרָעָב֙ לָב֔וֹא כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּכָל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וּבְכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם׃
verses.on: וּשְׁרִיאַת שְׁבַע שְׁנֵי כַפְנָא לְמֵיעַל כְּמָא דִּי אֲמַר יוֹסֵף וַהֲוָה כַפְנָא בְּכָל אַרְעֲתָא וּבְכָל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם הֲוָה לַחְמָא
verses.en: The seven years of famine started to come, just as Yoseif had said. There was famine in all the lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

oe.t: The seven years of famine started to come, just as Yoseif had said. There was famine in all the lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.he: וַתִּרְעַב֙ כָּל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֛ם אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַלָּ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לְכָל־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.on: וּכְפָנַת כָּל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם וּצְוַח עַמָּא קֳדָם לְפַרְעֹה עַל לַחְמָא וַאֲמַר פַּרְעֹה לְכָל מִצְרָאֵי אִיזִילוּ לְוַת יוֹסֵף דִּי יֵימַר לְכוֹן תַּעְבְּדוּן
verses.en: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried out to Pharaoh for bread. Pharaoh said to all of Egypt, Go to Yoseif. Whatever he says to you, do.

oe.t: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried out to Pharaoh for bread. Pharaoh said to all of Egypt [
the Egyptians
], Go to Yoseif. Whatever he says to you, do.

verses.he: וְהָרָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָֽרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וְכַפְנָא הֲוָה עַל כָּל אַפֵּי אַרְעָא וּפְתַח יוֹסֵף יָת כָּל דִּי בְהוֹן עִיבוּרָא וְזַבִּין לְמִצְרַיִם וּתְקֵיף כַּפְנָא בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: The famine spread over the entire face of the land. Yoseif opened everything that held grain, and sold [grain] to the Egyptians. The famine became severe in the land of Egypt.

oe.t: The famine spread over the entire face of the land. Yoseif opened everything that held grain, and sold [grain] to the Egyptians [
Egypt
]. The famine became severe in the land of Egypt.

verses.he: וְכָל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּֽי־חָזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.on: וְכָל דָּיְרֵי אַרְעָא עַלּוּ לְמִצְרַיִם לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא מִן יוֹסֵף אֲרֵי תְקֵיף כַּפְנָא בְּכָל אַרְעָא
verses.en: All [countries] of the land came to Egypt to buy [grain] from Yoseif, for the famine was severe in all the land.

oe.t: All [countries] [
inhabitants
] of the land came to Egypt to buy [grain] from Yoseif, for the famine was severe in all the land.

verses.he: וַיַּ֣רְא יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ לְבָנָ֔יו לָ֖מָּה תִּתְרָאֽוּ׃
verses.on: וַחֲזָא יַעֲקֹב אֲרֵי אִית עִיבוּרָא מִזְדַּבַּן בְּמִצְרָיִם וַאֲמַר יַעֲקֹב לִבְנוֹהִי לְמָא תִּתְחֲזוּן
verses.en: Yaakov saw that food was being sold in Egypt. Yaakov said to his sons, Why would you have everyone gazing at you?

oe.t: Yaakov saw that food [
grain
] was being sold in Egypt. Yaakov said to his sons, Why would you have everyone gazing at you?

verses.he: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רְדוּ־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ וְשִׁבְרוּ־לָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְנִחְיֶ֖ה וְלֹ֥א נָמֽוּת׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר הָא שְׁמָעִית אָמְרִין אֲרֵי אִית עִיבוּרָא מִזְדַּבַּן בְּמִצְרָיִם חוּתוּ תַמָּן וּזְבוּנוּ לָנָא מִּתַּמָּן וְנֵחֵי וְלָא נְמוּת
verses.en: He said, Behold, I have heard that there is food for sale in Egypt. Go down there and buy for us from there, so that we will live and not die.

oe.t: He said, Behold, I have heard that there is food [
grain
] for sale in Egypt. Go down there and buy for us from there, so that we will live and not die.

verses.he: וַיֵּרְד֥וּ אֲחֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר בָּ֖ר מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וּנְחָתוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף עַסְרָא לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא מִמִּצְרָיִם
verses.en: Yoseif’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

oe.t: Yoseif’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

verses.he: וְאֶת־בִּנְיָמִין֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹא־שָׁלַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־אֶחָ֑יו כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן־יִקְרָאֶ֖נּוּ אָסֽוֹן׃
verses.on: וְיָת בִּנְיָמִין אֲחוּהִי דְיוֹסֵף לָא שְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב עִם אֲחוֹהִי אֲרֵי אֲמַר דִּלְמָא יְעַרְעִנֵּהּ מוֹתָא
verses.en: But Binyamin, Yoseif’s brother, Yaakov did not send along with his brothers, for he [Yaakov] said, Misfortune might befall him.

oe.t: But Binyamin, Yoseif’s brother, Yaakov did not send along with his brothers, for he [Yaakov] said, Misfortune [
Death
] might befall him.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבָּאִ֑ים כִּֽי־הָיָ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.on: וַאֲתוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא בְּגוֹ עָלַיָּא אֲרֵי הֲוָה כַפְנָא בְּאַרְעָא דִּכְנָעַן
verses.en: The sons of Yisrael came to buy among the others who came, for there was famine in the land of Canaan.

oe.t: The sons of Yisrael came to buy [
grain
] among the others who came, for there was famine in the land of Canaan.

verses.he: וְיוֹסֵ֗ף ה֚וּא הַשַּׁלִּ֣יט עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ ה֥וּא הַמַּשְׁבִּ֖יר לְכָל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֲחֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־ל֥וֹ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.on: וְיוֹסֵף הוּא דְּשַׁלִּיט עַל אַרְעָא הוּא דְזַבִּין עִיבוּרָא לְכָל עַמָּא דְאַרְעָא וַאֲתוֹ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף וּסְגִידוּ לֵהּ עַל אַפֵּיהוֹן עַל אַרְעָא
verses.en: Yoseif was the ruler over the land; he was the one who sold to all the people of the land. Yoseif’s brothers came and they prostrated themselves to him with their faces to the ground.

oe.t: Yoseif was the ruler over the land; he was the one who sold [
grain
] to all the people of the land. Yoseif’s brothers came and they prostrated themselves to him with their faces to the ground.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥רְא יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־אֶחָ֖יו וַיַּכִּרֵ֑ם וַיִּתְנַכֵּ֨ר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר אִתָּ֣ם קָשׁ֗וֹת וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֵאַ֣יִן בָּאתֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִשְׁבָּר־אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.on: וַחֲזָא יוֹסֵף יָת אֲחוֹהִי וְאִשְׁתְּמוֹדְעִנּוּן וְחַשִּׁיב מָה דְמַלֵּיל לְהוֹן וּמַלִּיל עִמְּהוֹן קַשְׁיָן וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן מְנָן אֲתֵיתוּן וַאֲמָרוּ מֵאַרְעָא דִּכְנַעַן לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא
verses.en: Yoseif saw his brothers and he recognized them, but he acted like a stranger to them. He spoke harshly to them, and said to them, Where did you come from? They said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

oe.t: Yoseif saw his brothers and he recognized them, but he acted like a stranger [
considered what he should say
] to them. He spoke harshly to them, and said to them, Where did you come from? They said, From the land of Canaan to buy food [
grain

verses.he: וַיַּכֵּ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶת־אֶחָ֑יו וְהֵ֖ם לֹ֥א הִכִּרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.on: וְאִשְׁתְּמוֹדַע יוֹסֵף יָת אֲחוֹהִי וְאִנּוּן לָא אִשְׁתְּמוֹדְעוֹהִי
verses.en: Yoseif recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.

oe.t: Yoseif recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.

verses.he: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת הַחֲלֹמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָלַ֖ם לָהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מְרַגְּלִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לִרְא֛וֹת אֶת־עֶרְוַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּאתֶֽם׃
verses.on: וּדְכִיר יוֹסֵף יָת חֶלְמַיָּא דִּי חֲלִים לְהוֹן וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן מְאַלְלִין אַתּוּן לְמֶחֱזֵי יָת בִּדְקָא דְאַרְעָא אֲתֵיתוּן
verses.en: Yoseif recalled the dreams that he had dreamt about them, and said to them, You are spies. You have come to see where the land is exposed.

oe.t: Yoseif recalled the dreams that he had dreamt about them, and said to them, You are spies. You have come to see where the land is exposed [
the defective part of the land

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו לֹ֣א אֲדֹנִ֑י וַעֲבָדֶ֥יךָ בָּ֖אוּ לִשְׁבָּר־אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ לֵהּ לָא רִבּוֹנִי וְעַבְדָּיךְ עַלּוּ לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא
verses.en: They said to him, No my master. Your servants have come to buy food.

oe.t: They said to him, No my master. Your servants have come to buy food [
grain

verses.he: כֻּלָּ֕נוּ בְּנֵ֥י אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד נָ֑חְנוּ כֵּנִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ לֹא־הָי֥וּ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מְרַגְּלִֽים׃
verses.on: כֻּלָּנָא בְּנֵי גַּבְרָא חַד נָחְנָא כֵּיוָנֵי אֲנַחְנָא לָא הֲווֹ עַבְדָיךְ אַלִּילֵי
verses.en: We are all the sons of one man. We are honest [men]. Your servants have never been spies.

oe.t: We are all the sons of one man. We are honest [men]. Your servants have never been spies.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם לֹ֕א כִּֽי־עֶרְוַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּאתֶ֥ם לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן לָא אֲרֵי בִדְקָא דְאַרְעָא אֲתֵיתוּן לְמֶחֱזֵי
verses.en: He said to them, No, You have come to see where the land is exposed.

oe.t: He said to them, No, You have come to see where the land is exposed [
the defective part of the land

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂר֩ עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ אַחִ֧ים ׀ אֲנַ֛חְנוּ בְּנֵ֥י אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַקָּטֹ֤ן אֶת־אָבִ֙ינוּ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְהָאֶחָ֖ד אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ תְּרֵין עֲשַׂר עַבְדָיךְ אַחִין אֲנַחְנָא בְּנֵי גַּבְרָא חַד בְּאַרְעָא דִּכְנָעַן וְהָא זְעֵירָא עִם אָבוּנָא יוֹמָא דֵּין וְחַד לֵיתוֹהִי
verses.en: They said, Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. Behold the youngest one is this day with our father, and one is no more.

oe.t: They said, Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. Behold the youngest one is this day with our father, and one is no more.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֖ם יוֹסֵ֑ף ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֲלֵכֶ֛ם לֵאמֹ֖ר מְרַגְּלִ֥ים אַתֶּֽם׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן יוֹסֵף הוּא דִּי מַלֵּילִית עִמְּכוֹן לְמֵימַר אַלִּילֵי אַתּוּן
verses.en: Yoseif said to them, That is just what I said to you, saying: you are spies.

oe.t: Yoseif said to them, That is just what I said to you, saying: you are spies.

verses.he: בְּזֹ֖את תִּבָּחֵ֑נוּ חֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ אִם־תֵּצְא֣וּ מִזֶּ֔ה כִּ֧י אִם־בְּב֛וֹא אֲחִיכֶ֥ם הַקָּטֹ֖ן הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.on: בְּדָא תִּתְבַּחֲרוּן חֵי פַרְעֹה אִם תִּפְקוּן מִכָּא אֶלָּהֵין בְּמֵתֵי אֲחוּכוֹן זְעֵירָא הָכָא
verses.en: You shall be tested in this manner. By Pharaoh’s life, you shall not leave from here unless your youngest brother comes here.

oe.t: You shall be tested in this manner. By Pharaoh’s life, you shall not leave from here unless your youngest brother comes here.

verses.he: שִׁלְח֨וּ מִכֶּ֣ם אֶחָד֮ וְיִקַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲחִיכֶם֒ וְאַתֶּם֙ הֵאָ֣סְר֔וּ וְיִבָּֽחֲנוּ֙ דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם הַֽאֱמֶ֖ת אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְאִם־לֹ֕א חֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה כִּ֥י מְרַגְּלִ֖ים אַתֶּֽם׃
verses.on: שְׁלָחוּ מִנְּכוֹן חַד וְיִדְבַּר יָת אֲחוּכוֹן וְאַתּוּן תִּתְאַסְרוּן וְיִתְבַּחֲרוּן פִּתְגָּמֵיכוֹן הַקְּשׁוֹטּ אַתּוּן אָמְרִין וְאִם לָא חֵי פַרְעֹה אֲרֵי אַלִּילֵי אַתּוּן
verses.en: Send one of you and let him bring your brother. You will remain locked up and your words will be tested whether there is any truth with you. If not, by Pharaoh’s life, you are spies.

oe.t: Send one of you and let him bring your brother. You will remain locked up and your words will be tested whether there is [
you speak
] any truth with you. If not, by Pharaoh’s life, you are spies.

verses.he: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛ם אֶל־מִשְׁמָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
verses.on: וּכְנַשׁ יָתְהוֹן לְבֵית מַטְרָא תְּלָתָא יוֹמִין
verses.en: He [then] put them together in prison for three days.

oe.t: He [then] put them together in prison for three days.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֤ם יוֹסֵף֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י זֹ֥את עֲשׂ֖וּ וִֽחְי֑וּ אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יָרֵֽא׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן יוֹסֵף בְּיוֹמָא תְלִיתָאָה דָּא עִבִידוּ וְאִתְקַיָּמוּ מִן קֳדָם יְיָ אֲנָא דָּחֵל
verses.en: Yoseif said to them on the third day, Do this and live. I fear God.

oe.t: Yoseif said to them on the third day, Do this and live. [
From before God
] I fear God.

verses.he: אִם־כֵּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם אֲחִיכֶ֣ם אֶחָ֔ד יֵאָסֵ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית מִשְׁמַרְכֶ֑ם וְאַתֶּם֙ לְכ֣וּ הָבִ֔יאוּ שֶׁ֖בֶר רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: אִם כֵּיוָנֵי אַתּוּן אֲחוּכוֹן חַד יִתְאַסַּר בְּבֵית מַטַּרְתְּכוֹן וְאַתּוּן אִיזִילוּ אוֹבִילוּ עִיבוּרָא דְּחַסִּיר בְּבָתֵּיכוֹן
verses.en: If you are honest, one of your brothers will be imprisoned in your place of guarding, and you [the others] go bring food for your famished households.

oe.t: If you are honest, one of your brothers will be imprisoned in your place of guarding, and you [the others] go bring food for your famished [
grain that is lacking in your
] households.

verses.he: וְאֶת־אֲחִיכֶ֤ם הַקָּטֹן֙ תָּבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔י וְיֵאָמְנ֥וּ דִבְרֵיכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵֽן׃
verses.on: וְיָת אֲחוּכוֹן זְעֵירָא תַּיְתוּן לְוָתִי וְיִתְהֵמְנוּן פִּתְגָּמֵיכוֹן וְלָא תְמוּתוּן וַעֲבָדוּ כֵן
verses.en: Bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words will be verified, and you will not die. They decided to do so.

oe.t: Bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words will be verified, and you will not die. They decided to do so.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֗יו אֲבָל֮ אֲשֵׁמִ֣ים ׀ אֲנַחְנוּ֮ עַל־אָחִינוּ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָאִ֜ינוּ צָרַ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ בְּהִתְחַֽנְנ֥וֹ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמָ֑עְנוּ עַל־כֵּן֙ בָּ֣אָה אֵלֵ֔ינוּ הַצָּרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ גְּבַר לַאֲחוּהִי בְּקוּשְׁטָּא חַיָּבִין אֲנַחְנָא עַל אָחוּנָא דִּי חֲזֵינָא עָקַת נַפְשֵׁהּ כַּד הֲוָה מִתְחַנֶּן לָנָא וְלָא קַבֵּלְנָא מִנֵּהּ עַל כֵּן אָתַת לְוָתָנָא עַקְתָא הָדָא
verses.en: They said to one another, In truth, we are guilty regarding our brother. We saw the anguish of his soul when he pleaded with us and we did not listen. That is why this trouble has come upon us.

oe.t: They said to one another, In truth, we are guilty regarding our brother. We saw the anguish of his soul when he pleaded with us and we did not listen [
obey him
]. That is why this trouble has come upon us.

verses.he: וַיַּעַן֩ רְאוּבֵ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר הֲלוֹא֩ אָמַ֨רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֧ם ׀ לֵאמֹ֛ר אַל־תֶּחֶטְא֥וּ בַיֶּ֖לֶד וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְגַם־דָּמ֖וֹ הִנֵּ֥ה נִדְרָֽשׁ׃
verses.on: וַאֲתֵיב רְאוּבֵן יָתְהוֹן לְמֵימָר הֲלָא אֲמָרִית לְוָתְכוֹן לְמֵימַר לָא תְחוֹבוּן בְּעוּלֵימָא וְלָא קַבֶּלְתּוּן וְאַף דְּמֵהּ הָא מִתְבְּעֵי
verses.en: Reuvein answered them saying, Did I not say to you to the following: Do not sin against the lad, but you did not listen; and now his blood is being avenged.

oe.t: Reuvein answered them saying, Did I not say to you to the following: Do not sin against the lad, but you did not listen [
obey
]; and now his blood is being avenged.

verses.he: וְהֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּ֥י הַמֵּלִ֖יץ בֵּינֹתָֽם׃
verses.on: וְאִנּוּן לָא יָדְעוּן אֲרֵי שְׁמִיעַ יוֹסֵף אֲרֵי מְתֻרְגְּמָן הֲוָה בֵינֵיהוֹן
verses.en: They did not know that Yoseif listened [understood], because the interpreter was between them.

oe.t: They did not know that Yoseif listened [understood], because the interpreter was between them.

verses.he: וַיִּסֹּ֥ב מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וַיֵּ֑בְךְּ וַיָּ֤שָׁב אֲלֵהֶם֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽאִתָּם֙ אֶת־שִׁמְע֔וֹן וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ר אֹת֖וֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְאִסְתַּחַר מֵעִלָּוֵיהוֹן וּבְכָא וְתָב לְוָתְהוֹן וּמַלֵּיל עִמְּהוֹן וּדְבַר מִלְּוַתְהוֹן יָת שִׁמְעוֹן וַאֲסַר יָתֵהּ לְעֵינֵיהוֹן
verses.en: He turned away from them and cried. He returned to them and spoke to them. He took Shimon from them, and had him bound before their eyes.

oe.t: He turned away from them and cried. He returned to them and spoke to them. He took Shimon from them, and had him bound before their eyes.

verses.he: וַיְצַ֣ו יוֹסֵ֗ף וַיְמַלְא֣וּ אֶת־כְּלֵיהֶם֮ בָּר֒ וּלְהָשִׁ֤יב כַּסְפֵּיהֶם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־שַׂקּ֔וֹ וְלָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם צֵדָ֖ה לַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ לָהֶ֖ם כֵּֽן׃
verses.on: וּפַקֵּיד יוֹסֵף וּמְלוֹ יָת מָנֵיהוֹן עִיבוּרָא וְלַאֲתָבָא כַסְפֵּיהוֹן גְּבַר לְסַקֵּהּ וּלְמִתַּן לְהוֹן זְוָדִין לְאָרְחָא וַעֲבַד לְהוֹן כֵּן
verses.en: Yoseif gave orders—and their vessels were filled with grain, and each one’s money was replaced in his sack; and they were given provisions for the journey. This is what he did for them.

oe.t: Yoseif gave orders—and their vessels were filled with grain, and each one’s money was replaced in his sack; and they were given provisions for the journey. This is what he did for them.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־שִׁבְרָ֖ם עַל־חֲמֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.on: וּנְטָלוּ יָת עִיבוּרְהוֹן עַל חֲמָרֵיהוֹן וַאֲזָלוּ מִתַּמָּן
verses.en: They placed their purchases of grain on their donkeys and they departed from there.

oe.t: They placed their purchases of grain on their donkeys and they departed from there.

verses.he: וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח הָאֶחָ֜ד אֶת־שַׂקּ֗וֹ לָתֵ֥ת מִסְפּ֛וֹא לַחֲמֹר֖וֹ בַּמָּל֑וֹן וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־כַּסְפּ֔וֹ וְהִנֵּה־ה֖וּא בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּפְתַח חַד יָת סַקֵּהּ לְמִתַּן כִּסְתָא לַחֲמָרֵהּ בְּבֵית מְבָתָא וַחֲזָא יָת כַּסְפֵּהּ וְהָא הוּא בְּפוּם טוֹעֲנֵהּ
verses.en: The one opened his sack, to feed his donkey where they stayed overnight, and he saw his money, for behold it was in the opening of his bag.

oe.t: The one opened his sack, to feed his donkey where they stayed overnight, and he saw his money, for behold it was in the opening of his bag.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־אֶחָיו֙ הוּשַׁ֣ב כַּסְפִּ֔י וְגַ֖ם הִנֵּ֣ה בְאַמְתַּחְתִּ֑י וַיֵּצֵ֣א לִבָּ֗ם וַיֶּֽחֶרְד֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַה־זֹּ֛את עָשָׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לָֽנוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לַאֲחוֹהִי אִתּוֹתַב כַּסְפִּי וְאַף הָא בְטּוֹעֲנִי וּנְפַק מַדַּע לִבְּהוֹן וּתְוָהוּ גְּבַר לַאֲחוּהִי לְמֵימַר מָה דָּא עֲבַד יְיָ לָנָא
verses.en: He said to his brothers. My money has been returned, and behold it is also in my bag. Their hearts failed them and they trembled, saying one to another, What is this that Elohim has done to us?

oe.t: He said to his brothers. My money has been returned, and behold it is also in my bag. [
The understanding of their
] Their hearts failed [
left
] them and they trembled, saying one to another, What is this that Elohim has done to us?

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֛אוּ אֶל־יַעֲקֹ֥ב אֲבִיהֶ֖ם אַ֣רְצָה כְּנָ֑עַן וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ אֵ֛ת כָּל־הַקֹּרֹ֥ת אֹתָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וַאֲתוֹ לְוַת יַעֲקֹב אֲבוּהוֹן אַרְעָא דִּכְנָעַן וְחַוִּיוּ לֵהּ יָת כָּל דְעַרְעָא יָתְהוֹן לְמֵימָר
verses.en: They came to their father Yaakov, to the land of Canaan, and they told him all that had happened to them, saying,

oe.t: They came to their father Yaakov, to the land of Canaan, and they told him all that had happened to them, saying,

verses.he: דִּ֠בֶּר הָאִ֨ישׁ אֲדֹנֵ֥י הָאָ֛רֶץ אִתָּ֖נוּ קָשׁ֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹתָ֔נוּ כִּֽמְרַגְּלִ֖ים אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.on: מַלֵּיל גַּבְרָא רִבּוֹנָא דְאַרְעָא עִמָּנָא קַשְׁיָן וִיהַב יָתָנָא כִּמְאַלִּילֵי יָת אַרְעָא
verses.en: The man, the master of the land spoke to us harshly; and considered us as spies of the land.

oe.t: The man, the master of the land spoke to us harshly; and considered us as spies of the land.

verses.he: וַנֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו כֵּנִ֣ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ לֹ֥א הָיִ֖ינוּ מְרַגְּלִֽים׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַרְנָא לֵהּ כֵּיוָנֵי אֲנָחְנָא לָא הֲוֵינָא אַלִּילֵי
verses.en: We said to him, We are honest people, we have never been spies.

oe.t: We said to him, We are honest people, we have never been spies.

verses.he: שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֲנַ֛חְנוּ אַחִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אָבִ֑ינוּ הָאֶחָ֣ד אֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְהַקָּטֹ֥ן הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־אָבִ֖ינוּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.on: תְּרֵין עֲסַר אֲנַחְנָא אַחִין בְּנֵי אָבוּנָא חַד לֵיתוֹהִי וּזְעֵירָא יוֹמָא דֵּין עִם אָבוּנָא בְּאַרְעָא דִּכְנָעַן
verses.en: We are twelve brothers, sons of our [the same] father. One is no more, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

oe.t: We are twelve brothers, sons of our [the same] father. One is no more, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ הָאִישׁ֙ אֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּזֹ֣את אֵדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כֵנִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אֲחִיכֶ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ הַנִּ֣יחוּ אִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּיכֶ֖ם קְח֥וּ וָלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לָנָא גַּבְרָא רִבּוֹנָא דְּאַרְעָא בְּדָא אִדַּע אֲרֵי כֵיוָנֵי אַתּוּן אֲחוּכוֹן חַד שְׁבוּקוּ לְוָתִי וְיָת עִיבוּרָא דְחַסִּיר בְּבָתֵּיכוֹן סִיבוּ וֶאֱזִילוּ
verses.en: The man, the master of the land, said to us, This is how I shall know that you are honest. Leave one of your brothers with me, and take food for your famished households and go.

oe.t: The man, the master of the land, said to us, This is how I shall know that you are honest. Leave one of your brothers with me, and take food for your famished [
grain that is lacking in your
] households and go.

verses.he: וְ֠הָבִיאוּ אֶת־אֲחִיכֶ֣ם הַקָּטֹן֮ אֵלַי֒ וְאֵֽדְעָ֗ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א מְרַגְּלִים֙ אַתֶּ֔ם כִּ֥י כֵנִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אֶת־אֲחִיכֶם֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּסְחָֽרוּ׃
verses.on: וְאַיְתִיאוּ יָת אֲחוּכוֹן זְעֵירָא לְוָתִי וְאִדַּע אֲרֵי לָא אַלִּילֵי אַתּוּן אֲרֵי כֵיוָנֵי אַתּוּן יָת אֲחוּכוֹן אֶתֵּן לְכוֹן וְיָת אַרְעָא תַּעְבְּדוּן בַּהּ סְחוֹרְתָּא
verses.en: Bring your youngest brother to me, and then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. I will return your brother to you, and you will [again] do business in the land.

oe.t: Bring your youngest brother to me, and then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. I will return your brother to you, and you will [again] do business in the land.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֗י הֵ֚ם מְרִיקִ֣ים שַׂקֵּיהֶ֔ם וְהִנֵּה־אִ֥ישׁ צְרוֹר־כַּסְפּ֖וֹ בְּשַׂקּ֑וֹ וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־צְרֹר֧וֹת כַּסְפֵּיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥מָּה וַאֲבִיהֶ֖ם וַיִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.on: וַהֲוָה אִנּוּן מְרִיקִין סַקֵּיהוֹן וְהָא גְּבַר צְרִיר כַּסְפֵּהּ בְּסַקֵּהּ וַחֲזוֹ יָת צְרָרֵי כַסְפֵּיהוֹן אִנּוּן וַאֲבוּהוֹן וּדְחִילוּ
verses.en: They were emptying their sacks, and behold each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. They saw their bundles of money—they and their father and they were afraid.

oe.t: They were emptying their sacks, and behold each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. They saw their bundles of money—they and their father and they were afraid.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֔ם אֹתִ֖י שִׁכַּלְתֶּ֑ם יוֹסֵ֤ף אֵינֶ֙נּוּ֙ וְשִׁמְע֣וֹן אֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־בִּנְיָמִ֣ן תִּקָּ֔חוּ עָלַ֖י הָי֥וּ כֻלָּֽנָה׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲבוּהוֹן יָתִי אַתְכֶּלְתּוּן יוֹסֵף לֵיתוֹהִי וְשִׁמְעוֹן לָא הֲוָה הָכָא (לֵיתוֹהִי) וְיָת בִּנְיָמִן תִּדְבְּרוּן עֲלַי הֲווֹ כָלְּהוֹן
verses.en: Yaakov, their father, said to them, You have deprived me of children; Yoseif is no more, Shimon is no more, and you would take Binyamin: All this has happened to me.

oe.t: Yaakov, their father, said to them, You have deprived me of children; Yoseif is no more [
not here
], Shimon is no more, and you would take Binyamin: All this has happened to me.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר רְאוּבֵן֙ אֶל־אָבִ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶת־שְׁנֵ֤י בָנַי֙ תָּמִ֔ית אִם־לֹ֥א אֲבִיאֶ֖נּוּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ תְּנָ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־יָדִ֔י וַאֲנִ֖י אֲשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר רְאוּבֵן לְוַת אֲבוּהִי לְמֵימַר יָת תְּרֵין בְּנַי תְּמִית אִם לָא אַיְתִנֵּהּ לְוָתָךְ הַב יָתֵהּ עַל יְדִי וַאֲנָא אֲתֵבִנֵּהּ לָךְ
verses.en: Reuvein spoke to his father saying, Put my two sons to death if I do not bring him [Binyamin] back to you. Give him into my hands, and I will return him to you.

oe.t: Reuvein spoke to his father saying, Put my two sons to death if I do not bring him [Binyamin] back to you. Give him into my hands, and I will return him to you.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־יֵרֵ֥ד בְּנִ֖י עִמָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אָחִ֨יו מֵ֜ת וְה֧וּא לְבַדּ֣וֹ נִשְׁאָ֗ר וּקְרָאָ֤הוּ אָסוֹן֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֧ם אֶת־שֵׂיבָתִ֛י בְּיָג֖וֹן שְׁאֽוֹלָה׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לָא יֵחוּת בְּרִי עִמְּכוֹן אֲרֵי אָחוּהִי מִית וְהוּא בִּלְחוֹדוֹהִי אִשְׁתָּאַר וִיעַרְעִנֵּהּ מוֹתָא בְּאָרְחָא דִּי תְהָכוּן בַּהּ וְתַחֲתוּן יָת שִׂיבְתִי בְּדָווֹנָא לִשְׁאוֹל
verses.en: He [Yaakov] said, My son will not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and only he remains. Should misfortune befall him on the way you are going, you will bring my white head down to the grave in sorrow.

oe.t: He [Yaakov] said, My son will not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and only he remains. Should misfortune [
death
] befall him on the way you are going, you will bring my white head down to the grave in sorrow.

verses.he: וְהָרָעָ֖ב כָּבֵ֥ד בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.on: וְכַפְנָא תַּקִּיף בְּאַרְעָא
verses.en: The famine was severe in the land.

oe.t: The famine was severe in the land.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כִּלּוּ֙ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל אֶת־הַשֶּׁ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ־לָ֥נוּ מְעַט־אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.on: וַהֲוָה כַּד שֵׁיצִיאוּ לְמֵיכַל יָת עִיבוּרָא דְּאַיְתִיאוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן אֲבוּהוֹן תּוּבוּ זְבוּנוּ לָנָא זְעֵיר עִיבוּרָא
verses.en: When they had finished eating the food that they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, Go back and buy a little food for us.

oe.t: When they had finished eating [
entirely comsumed
] the food [
grain
] that they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, Go back and buy a little food [
grain
] for us.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלָ֛יו יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הָעֵ֣ד הֵעִד֩ בָּ֨נוּ הָאִ֤ישׁ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹֽא־תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לֵהּ יְהוּדָה לְמֵימָר אַסְהָדָא אַסְהֵד בָּנָא גַּבְרָא לְמֵימָר לָא תֶחֱזוּן אַפַּי אֶלָּהֵין כַּד אָחוּכוֹן עִמְּכוֹן
verses.en: Yehudah spoke to him saying, The man warned us repeatedly, saying, You had better not see my face unless your brother is with you.

oe.t: Yehudah spoke to him saying, The man warned us repeatedly, saying, You had better not see my face unless your brother is with you.

verses.he: אִם־יֶשְׁךָ֛ מְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ אֶת־אָחִ֖ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ נֵרְדָ֕ה וְנִשְׁבְּרָ֥ה לְךָ֖ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.on: אִם אִיתָךְ מְשַׁלַּח יָת אָחוּנָא עִמָּנָא נֵיחוֹת וְנִזְבֵּן לָךְ עִיבוּרָא
verses.en: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

oe.t: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food [
grain
] for you.

verses.he: וְאִם־אֵינְךָ֥ מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ לֹ֣א נֵרֵ֑ד כִּֽי־הָאִ֞ישׁ אָמַ֤ר אֵלֵ֙ינוּ֙ לֹֽא־תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְאִם לֵיתָךְ מְשַׁלַּח לָא נֵיחוֹת אֲרֵי גַּבְרָא אֲמַר לָנָא לָא תֶחֱזוּן אַפַּי אֶלָּהֵין כַּד אֲחוּכוֹן עִמְּכוֹן
verses.en: But if you will not send [him] we will not go down; for the man said to us, You had better not see my face unless your brother is with you.

oe.t: But if you will not send [him] we will not go down; for the man said to us, You had better not see my face unless your brother is with you.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָמָ֥ה הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם לִ֑י לְהַגִּ֣יד לָאִ֔ישׁ הַע֥וֹד לָכֶ֖ם אָֽח׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמָה אַבְאֶשְׁתּוּן לִי לְחַוָּאָה לְגַבְרָא הַעַד כְּעַן לְכוֹן אָחָא
verses.en: Yisrael said, Why did you do such harm to me, by telling the man that you had another brother.

oe.t: Yisrael said, Why did you do such harm to me, by telling the man that you had another brother.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֡וּ שָׁא֣וֹל שָֽׁאַל־הָ֠אִישׁ לָ֣נוּ וּלְמֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר הַע֨וֹד אֲבִיכֶ֥ם חַי֙ הֲיֵ֣שׁ לָכֶ֣ם אָ֔ח וַנַ֨גֶּד־ל֔וֹ עַל־פִּ֖י הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲיָד֣וֹעַ נֵדַ֔ע כִּ֣י יֹאמַ֔ר הוֹרִ֖ידוּ אֶת־אֲחִיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ מִשְׁאַל שָׁאֵל גַּבְרָא לָנָא וּלְיַלָּדוּתָנָא לְמֵימַר הַעַד כְּעַן אֲבוּכוֹן קַיָּם הַאִית לְכוֹן אָחָא וְחַוֵּינָא לֵהּ עַל מֵימַר פִּתְגָּמַיָּא הָאִלֵּין הֲמִדַּע הֲוֵינָא יָדְעִין אֲרֵי יֵימַר אוֹחִיתוּ יָת אֲחוּכוֹן
verses.en: They said, The man asked us repeatedly, about ourselves and about our family, saying. Is your father still alive? Do you have a brother? We told him according to his words. Could we have known that he would say, Bring your brother down?

oe.t: They said, The man asked us repeatedly, about ourselves and about our family, saying. Is your father still alive? Do you have a brother? We told him according to his words. Could we have known that he would say, Bring your brother down?

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֗יו שִׁלְחָ֥ה הַנַּ֛עַר אִתִּ֖י וְנָק֣וּמָה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְנִֽחְיֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת גַּם־אֲנַ֥חְנוּ גַם־אַתָּ֖ה גַּם־טַפֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר יְהוּדָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבוּהִי שְׁלַח עוּלֵימָא עִמִּי וְנֵקוּם וְנֵזֵיל וְנֵיחֵי וְלָא נְמוּת אַף אֲנַחְנָא אַף אַתְּ אַף טַפְלָנָא
verses.en: Yehudah said to his father, Yisrael, Send the lad with me, and we will get up and go; let us live and not die, we, you and our children.

oe.t: Yehudah said to his father, Yisrael, Send the lad with me, and we will get up and go; let us live and not die, we, you and our children.

verses.he: אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶֽעֶרְבֶ֔נּוּ מִיָּדִ֖י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑נּוּ אִם־לֹ֨א הֲבִיאֹתִ֤יו אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְהִצַּגְתִּ֣יו לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְחָטָ֥אתִֽי לְךָ֖ כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.on: אֲנָא מְעָרַבְנָא בֵהּ מִן יְדִי תִּבְעִנֵּהּ אִם לָא אַיְתִנֵּהּ לָךְ וַאֲקֵימִנֵּהּ קֳדָמָךְ וְאֵהֵי חָטֵי לָךְ כָּל יוֹמַיָּא
verses.en: I will be security for him. You will demand him from my hand. If I do not bring him to you, and set him before you, I will have sinned to you for all time.

oe.t: I will be security for him. You will demand him from my hand. If I do not bring him to you, and set him before you, I will have sinned [
be a sinner
] to you for all time.

verses.he: כִּ֖י לוּלֵ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְנוּ כִּֽי־עַתָּ֥ה שַׁ֖בְנוּ זֶ֥ה פַעֲמָֽיִם׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי אִלּוּלָפוֹן בְּדָא אִתְעַכָּבְנָא אֲרֵי כְעַן תַּבְנָא דְּנַן תַּרְתֵּין זִמְנִין
verses.en: If we had not hesitated until now, we could have been there and back twice.

oe.t: If we had not hesitated until now, we could have been there and back twice.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֲבִיהֶ֗ם אִם־כֵּ֣ן ׀ אֵפוֹא֮ זֹ֣את עֲשׂוּ֒ קְח֞וּ מִזִּמְרַ֤ת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בִּכְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹרִ֥ידוּ לָאִ֖ישׁ מִנְחָ֑ה מְעַ֤ט צֳרִי֙ וּמְעַ֣ט דְּבַ֔שׁ נְכֹ֣את וָלֹ֔ט בָּטְנִ֖ים וּשְׁקֵדִֽים׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבוּהוֹן אִם כֵּן הָכָא דָּא עִיבִידוּ סִיבוּ מִדִּמְשַׁבַּח בְּאַרְעָא בְּמָנֵיכוֹן וְאוֹחִיתוּ לְגַבְרָא תִּקְרֻבְתָּא זְעֵיר קְטַף וּזְעֵיר דְּבַשׁ שְׁעַף וּלְטוֹם בָּטְנִין וְשִׁגְדִּין
verses.en: Their father Yisrael said to them, If so, here, this is what you must do: Take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels, and take an offering to the man, a little balsam, a little honey, gum, labdanum, pistachios and almonds.

oe.t: Their father Yisrael said to them, If so, here, this is what you must do: Take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels, and take an offering to the man, a little balsam, a little honey, gum, labdanum, pistachios and almonds.

verses.he: וְכֶ֥סֶף מִשְׁנֶ֖ה קְח֣וּ בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם וְאֶת־הַכֶּ֜סֶף הַמּוּשָׁ֨ב בְּפִ֤י אַמְתְּחֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תָּשִׁ֣יבוּ בְיֶדְכֶ֔ם אוּלַ֥י מִשְׁגֶּ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וְכַסְפָּא עַל חַד תְּרֵין סִיבוּ בְיֶדְכוֹן וְיָת כַּסְפָּא דְּאִתּוֹתַב בְּפוּם טוֹעֲנֵיכוֹן תְּתִיבוּן בְּיֶדְכוֹן מָאִים שָׁלוּ הוּא
verses.en: Take double the money in your hands; and the money that was returned in the opening of your bags return by your own hands. Perhaps it was an oversight.

oe.t: Take double the money in your hands; and the money that was returned in the opening of your bags return by your own hands. Perhaps it was an oversight.

verses.he: וְאֶת־אֲחִיכֶ֖ם קָ֑חוּ וְק֖וּמוּ שׁ֥וּבוּ אֶל־הָאִֽישׁ׃
verses.on: וְיָת אֲחוּכוֹן דְּבָרוּ וְקוּמוּ תּוּבוּ לְוַת גַּבְרָא
verses.en: Take your brother, get up and return to the man.

oe.t: Take your brother, get up and return to the man.

verses.he: וְאֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֗י יִתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם רַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ וְשִׁלַּ֥ח לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אַחֵ֖ר וְאֶת־בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וַאֲנִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכֹ֖לְתִּי שָׁכָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.on: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לְכוֹן רַחֲמִין קֳדָם גַּבְרָא וְיִפְטַר לְכוֹן יָת אֲחוּכוֹן אָחֳרָנָא וְיָת בִּנְיָמִין וַאֲנָא כְּמָא דְּאִתְכֵּלִית תְּכֵלִית
verses.en: May the Almighty, Shaddai, grant you compassion in the presence of the man, that he may release to you your other brother along with Binyamin. If I have been bereft of my children, I will be bereft.

oe.t: May the Almighty, Shaddai, grant you compassion in the presence of the man, that he may release to you your other brother along with Binyamin. If I have been bereft of my children, I will be bereft.

verses.he: וַיִּקְח֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וּמִשְׁנֶה־כֶּ֛סֶף לָקְח֥וּ בְיָדָ֖ם וְאֶת־בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַיָּקֻ֙מוּ֙ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.on: וּנְסִיבוּ גֻּבְרַיָּא יָת תִּקְרֻבְתָּא הָדָא וְעַל חַד תְּרֵין כַּסְפָּא נְסִיבוּ בִידֵיהוֹן וּדְבָרוּ יָת בִּנְיָמִן וְקָמוּ וּנְחָתוּ לְמִצְרַיִם וְקָמוּ קֳדָם יוֹסֵף
verses.en: The men took that offering, and they took double money in their hands, and [they took] Binyamin. They rose and went down to Egypt, and they stood before Yoseif.

oe.t: The men took that offering, and they took double money in their hands, and [they took] Binyamin. They rose and went down to Egypt, and they stood before Yoseif.

verses.he: וַיַּ֨רְא יוֹסֵ֣ף אִתָּם֮ אֶת־בִּנְיָמִין֒ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לַֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־בֵּית֔וֹ הָבֵ֥א אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַבָּ֑יְתָה וּטְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֙בַח֙ וְהָכֵ֔ן כִּ֥י אִתִּ֛י יֹאכְל֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וַחֲזָא יוֹסֵף עִמְּהוֹן יָת בִּנְיָמִין וַאֲמַר לְדִי מְמַנָּא עַל בֵּיתֵהּ אָעֵיל יָת גֻּבְרַיָּא לְבֵיתָא וּנְכוֹס נִכְסָתָא וְאַתְקֵין אֲרֵי עִמִּי יֵיכְלוּן גֻּבְרַיָּא בְּשֵׁירוּתָא
verses.en: When Yoseif saw Binyamin with them he said to the one in charge of his house, Bring these men to the house. Slaughter an animal and prepare it, for these men shall dine with me at noon.

oe.t: When Yoseif saw Binyamin with them he said to the one in charge of his house, Bring these men to the house. Slaughter an animal and prepare it, for these men shall dine with me at noon [
the morning meal

verses.he: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָאִ֔ישׁ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיָּבֵ֥א הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֥יתָה יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.on: וַעֲבַד גַּבְרָא כְּמָא דִּי אֲמַר יוֹסֵף וְאָעֵיל גַּבְרָא יָת גֻּבְרַיָּא לְבֵית יוֹסֵף
verses.en: The man did as Yoseif said, and the man brought the men to the house of Yoseif.

oe.t: The man did as Yoseif said, and the man brought the men to the house of Yoseif.

verses.he: וַיִּֽירְא֣וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּ֣י הֽוּבְאוּ֮ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵף֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ עַל־דְּבַ֤ר הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ הַשָּׁ֤ב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ בַּתְּחִלָּ֔ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מֽוּבָאִ֑ים לְהִתְגֹּלֵ֤ל עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּ֣ל עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְלָקַ֧חַת אֹתָ֛נוּ לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.on: וּדְחִילוּ גֻּבְרַיָּא אֲרֵי אִתַּעֲלוּ לְבֵית יוֹסֵף וַאֲמָרוּ עַל עֵסַק כַּסְפָּא דְּאִתּוֹתַב בְּטוֹעֲנָנָא בְּקַדְמֵיתָא אֲנַחְנָא מִתַּעֲלִין לְאִתְרַבְרָבָא עֲלָנָא וּלְאִסְתַּקָּפָא עֲלָנָא וּלְמִקְנֵי יָתָנָא לְעַבְדִּין וּלְמִדְבַּר יָת חֲמָרָנָא
verses.en: The men were afraid because they had been brought to Yoseif’s house, and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our bags previously are we being brought [here]; that he may turn on us and come down on us, and take us for slaves along with our donkeys.

oe.t: The men were afraid because they had been brought to Yoseif’s house, and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our bags previously are we being brought [here]; that he may turn on [
act as a lord over
] us and come down on [
libel
] us, and take [
acquire
] us for slaves along with [
and take
] our donkeys.

verses.he: וַֽיִּגְּשׁוּ֙ אֶל־הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו פֶּ֥תַח הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.on: וּקְרִיבוּ לְוַת גַּבְרָא דִּי מְמַנָּא עַל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וּמַלִּילוּ עִמֵּהּ בִּתְרַע בֵּיתָא
verses.en: They approached the man, who was in charge of Yoseif’s house, and they spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

oe.t: They approached the man, who was in charge of Yoseif’s house, and they spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֑י יָרֹ֥ד יָרַ֛דְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּ֖ה לִשְׁבָּר־אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ בְּבָעוּ רִבּוֹנִי מֵיחַת נִחֵתְנָא בְּקַדְמֵיתָא לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא
verses.en: They said, Please, my master, we came down the first time to buy food.

oe.t: They said, Please, my master, we came down the first time to buy food [
grain

verses.he: וַֽיְהִ֞י כִּי־בָ֣אנוּ אֶל־הַמָּל֗וֹן וַֽנִּפְתְּחָה֙ אֶת־אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהִנֵּ֤ה כֶֽסֶף־אִישׁ֙ בְּפִ֣י אַמְתַּחְתּ֔וֹ כַּסְפֵּ֖נוּ בְּמִשְׁקָל֑וֹ וַנָּ֥שֶׁב אֹת֖וֹ בְּיָדֵֽנוּ׃
verses.on: וַהֲוָה כַּד אָתֵינָא לְבֵית מְבָתָא וּפְתַחְנָא יָת טוֹעֲנָנָא וְהָא כְסַף גְּבַר בְּפוּם טוֹעֲנֵהּ כַּסְפָּנָא בְּמַתְקְלֵהּ וַאֲתֵיבְנָא יָתֵהּ בִּידָנָא
verses.en: When we came to the inn and opened our bags, behold each man’s money was in the opening of his bag. It was our own money in its full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

oe.t: When we came to the inn and opened our bags, behold each man’s money was in the opening of his bag. It was our own money in its full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

verses.he: וְכֶ֧סֶף אַחֵ֛ר הוֹרַ֥דְנוּ בְיָדֵ֖נוּ לִשְׁבָּר־אֹ֑כֶל לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְנוּ מִי־שָׂ֥ם כַּסְפֵּ֖נוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.on: וְכַסְפָּא אָחֳרָנָא אוֹחִיתְנָא בִידָנָא לְמִזְבַּן עִיבוּרָא לָא יְדַעְנָא מָן שַׁוִּי כַסְפָּנָא בְּטוֹעֲנָנָא
verses.en: We have [also] brought other money in our hand to buy food. We do not know who put the money in our bags.

oe.t: We have [also] brought other money in our hand to buy food [
grain
]. We do not know who put the money in our bags.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ שָׁל֨וֹם לָכֶ֜ם אַל־תִּירָ֗אוּ אֱלֹ֨הֵיכֶ֜ם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י אֲבִיכֶם֙ נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם מַטְמוֹן֙ בְּאַמְתְּחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כַּסְפְּכֶ֖ם בָּ֣א אֵלָ֑י וַיּוֹצֵ֥א אֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר שְׁלַם לְכוֹן לָא תִדְחֲלוּן אֱלָהֲכוֹן וֵאֱלָהָא דַּאֲבוּכוֹן יְהַב לְכוֹן סִימָּא בְּטוֹעֲנֵיכוֹן כַּסְפְּכוֹן אֲתָא לְוָתִי וְאַפֵּיק לְוָתְהוֹן יָת שִׁמְעוֹן
verses.en: He [the man] said, Peace be with you, do not fear. Your God, and the God of your fathers, has given you a hidden gift in your bags. Your money has come to me. He then brought Shimon out to them.

oe.t: He [the man] said, Peace be with you, do not fear. Your God, and the God of your fathers, has given you a hidden gift in your bags. Your money has come to me. He then brought Shimon out to them.

verses.he: וַיָּבֵ֥א הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֣יתָה יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיִּתֶּן־מַ֙יִם֙ וַיִּרְחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן מִסְפּ֖וֹא לַחֲמֹֽרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְאָעֵיל גַּבְרָא יָת גֻּבְרַיָּא לְבֵית יוֹסֵף וִיהַב מַיָּא וְאַסְחוֹ רִגְלֵיהוֹן וִיהַב כִּסְּתָא לַחֲמָרֵיהוֹן
verses.en: The man brought the men into the house of Yoseif. He gave them water and they washed their feet. He had feed given to their donkeys.

oe.t: The man brought the men into the house of Yoseif. He gave them water and they washed their feet. He had feed given to their donkeys.

verses.he: וַיָּכִ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה עַד־בּ֥וֹא יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּי־שָׁ֖ם יֹ֥אכְלוּ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.on: וְאַתְקִינוּ יָת תִּקְרֻבְתָּא עַד דְּעַל יוֹסֵף בְּשֵׁירוּתָא אֲרֵי שְׁמָעוּ אֲרֵי תַמָּן יֵיכְלוּן לַחֲמָא
verses.en: They prepared their offering [to be ready] when Yoseif came at noon, for they had heard that they would eat there.

oe.t: They prepared their offering [to be ready] when Yoseif came at noon [
to the morning meal
], for they had heard that they would eat there.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיָּבִ֥יאּוּ ל֛וֹ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדָ֖ם הַבָּ֑יְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.on: וְעַל יוֹסֵף לְבֵיתָא וְאַיְתִיאוּ לֵהּ יָת תִּקְרֻבְתָּא דִּי בִידֵיהוֹן לְבֵיתָא וּסְגִידוּ לֵהּ לְאַרְעָא
verses.en: Yoseif came to the house, and they brought the offering that was in their hand, to him in the house. They prostrated themselves on the ground to him.

oe.t: Yoseif came to the house, and they brought the offering that was in their hand, to him in the house. They prostrated themselves on the ground to him.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל לָהֶם֙ לְשָׁל֔וֹם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲשָׁל֛וֹם אֲבִיכֶ֥ם הַזָּקֵ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הַעוֹדֶ֖נּוּ חָֽי׃
verses.on: וּשְׁאֵיל לְהוֹן לִשְׁלַם וַאֲמַר הַשְׁלַם אֲבוּכוֹן סָבָא דִּי אֲמַרְתּוּן הַעַד כְּעַן קַיָּם
verses.en: He inquired about their welfare, and said, Is your old father at peace, the one about whom you spoke? Is he still alive?

oe.t: He inquired about their welfare, and said, Is your old father at peace, the one about whom you spoke? Is he still alive?

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ שָׁל֛וֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ֥ לְאָבִ֖ינוּ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חָ֑י וַֽיִּקְּד֖וּ וישתחו [וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃]
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ שְׁלַם לְעַבְדָךְ לְאָבוּנָא עַד כְּעַן קַיָּם וּכְרָעוּ וּסְגִידוּ
verses.en: They said, Your servant, our father is at peace. He is still alive. They bowed their heads and prostrated themselves.

oe.t: They said, Your servant, our father is at peace. He is still alive. They bowed their heads and prostrated themselves.

verses.he: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־בִּנְיָמִ֣ין אָחִיו֮ בֶּן־אִמּוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲזֶה֙ אֲחִיכֶ֣ם הַקָּטֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים יָחְנְךָ֖ בְּנִֽי׃
verses.on: וּזְקַף עֵינוֹהִי וַחֲזָא יָת בִּנְיָמִין אֲחוּהִי בַּר אִמֵּהּ וַאֲמַר הָדֵין אֲחוּכוֹן זְעֵירָא דִּי אֲמַרְתּוּן לִי וַאֲמַר מִן קֳדָם יְיָ יִתְרַחַם עֲלָךְ בְּרִי
verses.en: He raised his eyes and saw his brother Binyamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your youngest brother of whom you spoke to me? He [then] said, Elohim be gracious to you my son.

oe.t: He raised his eyes and saw his brother Binyamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your youngest brother of whom you spoke to me? He [then] said, Elohim be gracious to you [
Graciousness from before Elohim be upon you
] my son.

verses.he: וַיְמַהֵ֣ר יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּֽי־נִכְמְר֤וּ רַחֲמָיו֙ אֶל־אָחִ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לִבְכּ֑וֹת וַיָּבֹ֥א הַחַ֖דְרָה וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.on: וְאוֹחִי יוֹסֵף אֲרֵי אִתְגּוֹלְלוּ רַחֲמוֹהִי עַל אֲחוּהִי וּבְעָא לְמִבְכֵּי וְעַל לְאִדְרוֹן בֵּית מִשְׁכְּבָא וּבְכָא תַמָּן
verses.en: Yoseif hurried [to go out] because his compassion was aroused toward his brother, and he wanted to weep. He went into [his] room and wept there.

oe.t: Yoseif hurried [to go out] because his compassion was aroused toward his brother, and he wanted to weep. He went into [his] [
bed
]room and wept there.

verses.he: וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ פָּנָ֖יו וַיֵּצֵ֑א וַיִּ֨תְאַפַּ֔ק וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׂ֥ימוּ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.on: וְאַסְחֵי אַפּוֹהִי וּנְפָק וְאִתְחַסִּין וַאֲמַר שַׁווּ לַחֲמָא
verses.en: He washed his face and came out. He composed himself, and said, Serve bread.

oe.t: He washed his face and came out. He composed himself, and said, Serve bread.

verses.he: וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ ל֛וֹ לְבַדּ֖וֹ וְלָהֶ֣ם לְבַדָּ֑ם וְלַמִּצְרִ֞ים הָאֹכְלִ֤ים אִתּוֹ֙ לְבַדָּ֔ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוּכְל֜וּן הַמִּצְרִ֗ים לֶאֱכֹ֤ל אֶת־הָֽעִבְרִים֙ לֶ֔חֶם כִּי־תוֹעֵבָ֥ה הִ֖וא לְמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: וְשַׁוִּיאוּ לֵהּ בִּלְחוֹדוֹהִי וּלְהוֹן בִּלְחוֹדֵיהוֹן וּלְמִצְרָאֵי דְּאָכְלִין עִמֵּהּ בִּלְחוֹדֵיהוֹן אֲרֵי לָא יָכְלִין מִצְרָאֵי לְמֵיכַל עִם עִבְרָאֵי לַחְמָא אֲרֵי בְעִירָא דְּמִצְרָאֵי דָחֲלִין לֵהּ עִבְרָאֵי אָכְלִין
verses.en: They set [a place] for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, since the Egyptians could not eat food with the Hebrews, because it was loathsome to the Egyptians.

oe.t: They set [a place] for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, since the Egyptians could not eat food with the Hebrews, because it was loathsome to the [
the animal that the
] Egyptians [
worship, the Hebrews eat

verses.he: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו הַבְּכֹר֙ כִּבְכֹ֣רָת֔וֹ וְהַצָּעִ֖יר כִּצְעִרָת֑וֹ וַיִּתְמְה֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.on: וְאַסְחָרוּ קֳדָמוֹהִי רַבָּא כְּרַבְיוּתֵהּ וּזְעִירָא כִּזְעֵרוּתֵהּ וּתְמָהוּ גֻּבְרַיָּא גְּבַר לְחַבְרֵהּ
verses.en: They were seated before him, the first born [the oldest] according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth. The men looked at each other in astonishment.

oe.t: They were seated [
reclined
] before him, the first born [the oldest] according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth. The men looked at each other in astonishment.

verses.he: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א מַשְׂאֹ֜ת מֵאֵ֣ת פָּנָיו֮ אֲלֵהֶם֒ וַתֵּ֜רֶב מַשְׂאַ֧ת בִּנְיָמִ֛ן מִמַּשְׂאֹ֥ת כֻּלָּ֖ם חָמֵ֣שׁ יָד֑וֹת וַיִּשְׁתּ֥וּ וַֽיִּשְׁכְּר֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּנְטַלּ חֳלָקִין מִן קֳדָמוֹהִי לָקֳדָמֵיהוֹן וּסְגִי חֲלָקָא דְבִנְיָמִן מֵחֳלָקֵי דְכָלְּהוֹן חַמְשָׁא חֳלָקִין וּשְׁתִיאוּ וּרְוִיאוּ עִמֵּהּ
verses.en: He had portions carried from before him to them. Binyomin’s portions was greater than all of their’s—five times as much. They drank with him and became intoxicated.

oe.t: He had portions carried from before him to [
before
] them. Binyomin’s portions was greater than all of their’s—five times as much. They drank with him and became intoxicated.

verses.he: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־בֵּיתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ מַלֵּ֞א אֶת־אַמְתְּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֹ֔כֶל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּכְל֖וּן שְׂאֵ֑ת וְשִׂ֥ים כֶּֽסֶף־אִ֖ישׁ בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּפַקֵּיד יָת דִּי מְמַנָּא עַל בֵּיתֵהּ לְמֵימַר מְלֵי יָת טוֹעֲנֵי גֻּבְרַיָּא עִיבוּרָא כְּמָא דִּי יָכְלִין לְמִטְּעַן וְשַׁוִּי כְסַף גְּבַר בְּפוּם טוֹעֲנֵהּ
verses.en: He commanded the one in charge of his house, saying, Fill the men’s bags with as much food as they can carry, and place each man’s money in the opening of his bag.

oe.t: He commanded the one in charge of his house, saying, Fill the men’s bags with as much food [
grain
] as they can carry, and place each man’s money in the opening of his bag.

verses.he: וְאֶת־גְּבִיעִ֞י גְּבִ֣יעַ הַכֶּ֗סֶף תָּשִׂים֙ בְּפִי֙ אַמְתַּ֣חַת הַקָּטֹ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף שִׁבְר֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.on: וְיָת כַּלִּידִי כַּלִּידָא דְכַסְפָּא תְּשַׁוֵּי בְּפוּם טוֹעֲנָא דִּזְעֵירָא וְיָת כְּסַף זְבִינוֹהִי וַעֲבַּד כְּפִתְגָּמָא דְּיוֹסֵף דִּי מַלִּיל
verses.en: And my goblet, the silver goblet, put in the opening of the youngest one’s bag, together with the money for his purchase of food. He acted according to the word Yoseif had spoken.

oe.t: And my goblet, the silver goblet, put in the opening of the youngest one’s bag, together with the money for his purchase of food. He acted according to the word Yoseif had spoken.

verses.he: הַבֹּ֖קֶר א֑וֹר וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים שֻׁלְּח֔וּ הֵ֖מָּה וַחֲמֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.on: צַפְרָא נְהָר וְגֻבְרַיָּא אִתְפַּטָּרוּ אִנּוּן וַחֲמָרֵיהוֹן
verses.en: With the morning light, the men were sent [on their way] together with their donkeys.

oe.t: With the morning light, the men were sent [on their way] together with their donkeys.

verses.he: הֵ֠ם יָֽצְא֣וּ אֶת־הָעִיר֮ לֹ֣א הִרְחִיקוּ֒ וְיוֹסֵ֤ף אָמַר֙ לַֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־בֵּית֔וֹ ק֥וּם רְדֹ֖ף אַחֲרֵ֣י הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְהִשַּׂגְתָּם֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לָ֛מָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּ֥ם רָעָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.on: אִנּוּן נְפָקוּ מִן קַרְתָּא לָא אַרְחִיקוּ וְיוֹסֵף אֲמַר לְדִי מְמַנָּא עַל בֵּיתֵהּ קוּם רְדַף בָּתַר גֻּבְרַיָּא וְתַדְבְּקִנּוּן וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן לְמָה שַׁלֶמְתּוּן בִּישָׁא חֳלָף טַבְתָא
verses.en: They had just left the city, they had not gone far, when Yoseif said to the one in charge of his house, Get up, pursue the men, and when you catch up with them, say to them, Why did you repay good with evil.

oe.t: They had just left the city, they had not gone far, when Yoseif said to the one in charge of his house, Get up, pursue the men, and when you catch up with them, say to them, Why did you repay good with evil.

verses.he: הֲל֣וֹא זֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁתֶּ֤ה אֲדֹנִי֙ בּ֔וֹ וְה֕וּא נַחֵ֥שׁ יְנַחֵ֖שׁ בּ֑וֹ הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.on: הֲלָא דֵּין דְּשָׁתֵי רִבּוֹנִי בֵּהּ וְהוּא בָּדָקָא מְבָדֵק בֵּהּ אַבְאֶשְׁתּוּן דִּי עֲבַדְתּוּן
verses.en: Why, this is [the goblet] from which my master drinks. He uses it for divination. You have acted badly in what you have done.

oe.t: Why, this is [the goblet] from which my master drinks. He uses it for divination [
investigating
]. You have acted badly in what you have done.

verses.he: וַֽיַּשִּׂגֵ֑ם וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.on: וְאַדְבֵּיקִנּוּן וּמַלֵּיל עִמְּהוֹן יָת פִּתְגָּמַיָּא הָאִלֵּין
verses.en: He caught up with them, and spoke these exact words to them.

oe.t: He caught up with them, and spoke these exact words to them.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו לָ֚מָּה יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה חָלִ֙ילָה֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ מֵעֲשׂ֖וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרוּ לֵהּ לְמָה יְמַלֵּל רִבּוֹנִי כְּפִתְגָּמַיָּא הָאִלֵּין חַס לְעַבְדָּיךְ מִלְּמֶעְבַּד כְּפִתְגָּמָא הָדֵין
verses.en: They said to him, Why does my master speak such words? It would be degrading for your servants to do such a thing.

oe.t: They said to him, Why does my master speak such words? It would be degrading for your servants to do [
May your servants be spared from doing
] such a thing.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָצָ֙אנוּ֙ בְּפִ֣י אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔ינוּ הֱשִׁיבֹ֥נוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאֵ֗יךְ נִגְנֹב֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ כֶּ֖סֶף א֥וֹ זָהָֽב׃
verses.on: הָא כַסְפָּא דִּי אַשְׁכַּחְנָא בְּפוּם טּוֹעֲנָנָא אֲתֵיבְנוֹהִי לָךְ מֵאַרְעָא דִּכְנָעַן וְאֶכְדֵּין נִגְנוּב מִבֵּית רִבּוֹנָךְ כַּסְפָּא אוֹ דַּהֲבָא (מָנִין דִּכְסַף אוֹ מָנִין דִּדְהָב)
verses.en: Behold the money that we found in the opening of our bags, we brought back to you from the land of Canaan. How then could we have stolen silver or gold from your master’s house?

oe.t: Behold the money that we found in the opening of our bags, we brought back to you from the land of Canaan. How then could we have stolen silver [
vessels
] or gold [
vessels
] from your master’s house?

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֥א אִתּ֛וֹ מֵעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וָמֵ֑ת וְגַם־אֲנַ֕חְנוּ נִֽהְיֶ֥ה לַֽאדֹנִ֖י לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.on: דִּי יִשְׁתְּכַח עִמֵּהּ מֵעַבְדָיךְ וּמִית וְאַף אַנַחְנָא נְהֵי לְרִבּוֹנִי לְעַבְדִין
verses.en: He among your servants with whom it is found, he shall die. We will also be servants to my master.

oe.t: He among your servants with whom it is found, he shall die. We will also be servants to my master.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־עַתָּ֥ה כְדִבְרֵיכֶ֖ם כֶּן־ה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ יִהְיֶה־לִּ֣י עָ֔בֶד וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְי֥וּ נְקִיִּֽם׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר אַף כְּעַן כְּפִתְגָּמֵיכוֹן כֶּן הוּא דִּי יִשְׁתְּכַח עִמֵּהּ יְהֵי לִי עַבְדָּא וְאַתּוּן תְּהוֹן זַכָּאִין
verses.en: And he said, Your words are now also correct. The one with whom it is found, he shall be my slave, and you shall be guiltless.

oe.t: And he said, Your words are now also correct. The one with whom it is found, he shall be my slave, and you shall be guiltless.

verses.he: וַֽיְמַהֲר֗וּ וַיּוֹרִ֛דוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אַמְתַּחְתּ֖וֹ אָ֑רְצָה וַֽיִּפְתְּח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאוֹחִיאוּ וְאוֹחִיתוּ גְּבַר יָת טּוֹעֲנֵהּ לְאַרְעָא וּפְתָחוּ גְּבַר טוֹעֲנֵהּ
verses.en: They hurried, and each man lowered his bag to the ground, and each man opened his bag.

oe.t: They hurried, and each man lowered his bag to the ground, and each man opened his bag.

verses.he: וַיְחַפֵּ֕שׂ בַּגָּד֣וֹל הֵחֵ֔ל וּבַקָּטֹ֖ן כִּלָּ֑ה וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ הַגָּבִ֔יעַ בְּאַמְתַּ֖חַת בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.on: וּבְלַשׁ בְּרַבָּא שָׁרֵי וּבִזְעֵירָא שֵׁצִי וְאִשְׁתְּכַח כַּלִּידָא בְּטוֹעֲנָא דְבִנְיָמִן
verses.en: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending with the youngest. The goblet was found in Binyomin’s bag.

oe.t: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending with the youngest. The goblet was found in Binyomin’s bag.

verses.he: וַֽיִּקְרְע֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲמֹס֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־חֲמֹר֔וֹ וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הָעִֽירָה׃
verses.on: וּבְזָעוּ לְבוּשֵׁיהוֹן וּרְמוֹ גְּבַר עַל חֲמָרֵהּ וְתָבוּ לְקַרְתָּא
verses.en: They tore their garments [in grief]. Each man loaded his donkey, and they returned to the city.

oe.t: They tore their garments [in grief]. Each man loaded his donkey, and they returned to the city.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוּדָ֤ה וְאֶחָיו֙ בֵּ֣יתָה יוֹסֵ֔ף וְה֖וּא עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּפְּל֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.on: וְעַל יְהוּדָּה וַאֲחוֹהִי לְבֵית יוֹסֵף וְהוּא עַד כְּעַן תַּמָּן וּנְפָלוּ קֳדָמוֹהִי לְאַרְעָא
verses.en: Yehudah and his brothers came to Yoseif’s house. He was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.

oe.t: Yehudah and his brothers came to Yoseif’s house. He was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף מָֽה־הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם הֲל֣וֹא יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּֽי־נַחֵ֧שׁ יְנַחֵ֛שׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּמֹֽנִי׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן יוֹסֵף מָה עוֹבָדָא הָדֵין דִּי עֲבַדְתּוּן הֲלָא יְדַּעְתּוּן אֲרֵי בָדָקָא מְבָדֵק גַּבְרָא דִּי כְוָתִי
verses.en: Yoseif said to them, What is this deed that you have done? Do you not know that a man like me is an expert diviner ?

oe.t: Yoseif said to them, What is this deed that you have done? Do you not know that a man like me is an expert diviner [
investigator

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה מַה־נֹּאמַר֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י מַה־נְּדַבֵּ֖ר וּמַה־נִּצְטַדָּ֑ק הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים מָצָא֙ אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ הִנֶּנּ֤וּ עֲבָדִים֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י גַּם־אֲנַ֕חְנוּ גַּ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־נִמְצָ֥א הַגָּבִ֖יעַ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר יְהוּדָה מַה נֵּימַר לְרִבּוֹנִי מַה נְּמַלֵּל וּמַה נִזְכֵּי מִן קֳדָם יְיָ אִשְׁתְּכַח יָת חוֹבָא דְעַבְדָּיךְ הָא אֲנַחְנָא עַבְדִּין לְרִבּוֹנִי אַף אֲנַחְנָא אַף דְּאִשְׁתְּכַח כַּלִּידָא בִּידֵהּ
verses.en: Yehudah said, What shall we say to my master? What can we speak? How can we justify ourselves? God has found the iniquity of your servants. Let us be slaves to my master, both we, and the one in whose hand the goblet was found.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֔י מֵעֲשׂ֖וֹת זֹ֑את הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א הַגָּבִ֜יעַ בְּיָד֗וֹ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶה־לִּ֣י עָ֔בֶד וְאַתֶּ֕ם עֲל֥וּ לְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־אֲבִיכֶֽם׃ (פ)
verses.on: וַאֲמַר חַס לִי מִלְּמֶעְבַּד דָּא גַּבְרָא דִּי אִשְׁתְּכַח כַּלִּידָא בִּידֵהּ הוּא יְהֵי לִי עַבְדָּא וְאַתּוּן סָקוֹ לִשְׁלַם לְוַת אֲבוּכוֹן: ססס
verses.en: He [Yoseif] said [to them], It would be degrading for me to do such a thing. The man in whose hand the goblet was found, he shall be my slave, and [the rest of] you go up in peace to your father.

oe.t: He [Yoseif] said [to them], It would be degrading for me to do [

] such a thing. The man in whose hand the goblet was found, he shall be my slave, and [the rest of] you go up in peace to your father.
